        all(isinstance(route[key], str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}(?:[0-9a-f]{24})?', route[key])
            for key in ('controller_record_oid', 'record_oid')) and route['decision'] == 'REQUIRED' and
        route['classification'] in ('MECHANICALLY_REQUIRED', 'JUDGEMENT_REQUIRED') and
        route['route_state'] in ('OPEN', 'RETURNED', 'SATISFIED'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_CANONICAL_ROUTE_BINDING')
    for item in (route['record_identity'], route['route_transaction_id'], route['obligation_id'], scope['host_correlation_id']):
        require(isinstance(item, str) and re.fullmatch('sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}', item), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_ROUTE_DIGEST_SHAPE')
    require(all(scope[key] == route[key] for key in ('controller_id', 'route_transaction_id', 'obligation_id')) and
        scope['host_id'] == 'codex' and scope['host_session_id'] == episode['parent_identity']['thread_id'] and
        all(isinstance(scope[key], str) and re.fullmatch('G[0-9A-F]{4}', scope[key])
            for key in ('host_binding_generation', 'continuity_generation')) and
        isinstance(scope['claim_id'], str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{32}', scope['claim_id']),
        'EPISODE_EXPORT_ROUTE_SCOPE_BINDING')
    receipt_prefix = 'refs/implementaudit/continuity-receipts/' + scope['controller_id'] + '/' + scope['continuity_generation'] + '@'
    require(isinstance(scope['continuity_receipt'], str) and
        re.fullmatch(re.escape(receipt_prefix) + '[0-9a-f]{40}(?:[0-9a-f]{24})?', scope['continuity_receipt']),
        'EPISODE_EXPORT_CONTINUITY_RECEIPT_BINDING')
    _episode_export_path(scope['explicit_run_root'])


def _episode_export_code_pins(pins):
    required = {'implementaudit/SKILL.md', 'audit-state/SKILL.md',
        'implementaudit/references/child-agents.md', 'implementaudit/references/continuity.md'}
    required.update('implementaudit/scripts/' + name for name in (
        'compaction-audit-pending.py', 'compaction-result-observation.py',
        'compaction-source-owner-codex-app.py', 'codex-recovery-native-reader.py',
        'bounded_file_custody.py', 'bounded_native_reader.py', 'bounded_source_owner.py',
        'host-session-binding.py', 'route-transaction.py'))
    require(type(pins) is dict and len(pins) == len(required) and
        all(type(key) is str and 0 < len(key) <= 256 and type(item) is str and
            re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', item) for key, item in pins.items()),
        'EPISODE_EXPORT_CODE_PIN_SHAPE')
    normalized = {key.replace('\\', '/') for key in pins}
    require(normalized == required and len(normalized) == len(pins), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_CODE_PIN_POPULATION')


def validate_frozen_episode_export_v1(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get('schema') == 'implementaudit.ordinary-episode-export.v1':
        return validate_ordinary_episode_export_v1(value)
    """Validate a captured projection only. No filesystem, native RPC or refresh.

    This function does not authenticate caller-authored facts. The collector
    must separately pin this owner and the fixed producer acquisition path.
    """
    closed(value, ('schema', 'status', 'reason_code', 'owner', 'episode', 'pending', 'lifecycle', 'occurrences', 'custody', 'export_digest', 'authority_ceiling'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_SHAPE')
    require(len(canonical(value)) <= MAX_TOTAL and value['schema'] == 'implementaudit.native-episode-export.v1' and (value['authority_ceiling'] == 'NONE') and (value['status'] in ('AVAILABLE', 'UNAVAILABLE')), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_BOUND')
    require(value['export_digest'] == digest(canonical({key: item for key, item in value.items() if key != 'export_digest'})), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_DIGEST')
    if value['status'] == 'UNAVAILABLE':
        require(value['reason_code'] in ('FIXED_SELECTION_UNBOUND', 'CANONICAL_EPISODE_ABSENT', 'PENDING_STATE_ABSENT', 'SELECTED_ASSIGNMENT_ABSENT', 'ADMITTED_JOIN_ABSENT') and all((value[key] is None for key in ('owner', 'episode', 'pending', 'lifecycle', 'occurrences', 'custody'))), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_ABSENCE_SHAPE')
        return value
    require(value['reason_code'] is None, 'EPISODE_EXPORT_PRESENT_REASON')
    owner = closed(value['owner'], ('profile_id', 'issuer_id', 'policy_digest', 'code_pins', 'canonical_opening_digest', 'canonical_route', 'host_and_scope'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_OWNER_SHAPE')
    issuers = {NONPROTECTED_PROFILE: 'codex-app-canonical-episode-public-source-v1', OWNED_STDIO_PROFILE: 'codex-owned-stdio-canonical-episode-public-source-v1'}
    require(owner['profile_id'] in issuers and owner['issuer_id'] == issuers[owner['profile_id']], 'EPISODE_EXPORT_OWNER_BINDING')
    _episode_export_code_pins(owner['code_pins'])
    episode = closed(value['episode'], ('parent_identity', 'actual_child_identity', 'assignment_identity', 'obligation_digest', 'observation_id', 'covered_boundary_versions', 'result_digest', 'acceptance_digest', 'Q_digest', 'E_digest'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_EPISODE_SHAPE')
    parent = closed(episode['parent_identity'], ('thread_id', 'agent_path'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_PARENT_SHAPE')
    child = closed(episode['actual_child_identity'], ('thread_id', 'parent_thread_id', 'agent_path'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_CHILD_SHAPE')
    require(all((isinstance(item, str) and 0 < len(item) <= 256 for item in (*parent.values(), *child.values()))) and child['parent_thread_id'] == parent['thread_id'] and (child['thread_id'] != parent['thread_id']) and child['agent_path'].startswith(parent['agent_path'] + '/'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_PARENT_CHILD_BINDING')
    _episode_export_route_binding(owner, episode)
    require(isinstance(owner['canonical_opening_digest'], str) and re.fullmatch('sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}', owner['canonical_opening_digest']), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_CANONICAL_OPENING_DIGEST')
    for item in (owner['policy_digest'], *(episode[key] for key in ('assignment_identity', 'obligation_digest', 'observation_id', 'result_digest', 'acceptance_digest', 'Q_digest', 'E_digest'))):
        require(isinstance(item, str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', item), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_DIGEST_SHAPE')
    _episode_export_scope(episode['covered_boundary_versions'])
    require(episode['covered_boundary_versions'] and all((row['kind'] == 'COMPLETED_RESUMED_BOUNDARY' for row in episode['covered_boundary_versions'])), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_REAL_BOUNDARY_REQUIRED')
    pending = closed(value['pending'], ('revision', 'observations', 'assignment_scope', 'covered_scope', 'pending_scope'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_PENDING_SHAPE')
    require(type(pending['revision']) is int and pending['revision'] >= 0 and isinstance(pending['observations'], list) and (len(pending['observations']) <= 4096), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_PENDING_BOUND')
    for field in ('assignment_scope', 'covered_scope', 'pending_scope'):
        _episode_export_scope(pending[field])
    require(pending['covered_scope'] == episode['covered_boundary_versions'] and all((row in pending['assignment_scope'] for row in pending['covered_scope'])), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_COVERAGE_BINDING')
    observations = {}
    for row in pending['observations']:
        closed(row, ('id', 'kind', 'version', 'consumed_version', 'assignment_children'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_PENDING_ROW_SHAPE')
        _episode_export_scope([{key: row[key] for key in ('id', 'kind', 'version')}])
        require(row['id'] not in observations and type(row['consumed_version']) is int and (0 <= row['consumed_version'] <= row['version']) and isinstance(row['assignment_children'], list) and (len(row['assignment_children']) <= 64) and (len(set(row['assignment_children'])) == len(row['assignment_children'])) and all((isinstance(item, str) and item for item in row['assignment_children'])), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_PENDING_ROW_BINDING')
        observations[row['id']] = row
    require(all(row['id'] in observations and observations[row['id']]['kind'] == row['kind'] and
        observations[row['id']]['version'] >= row['version'] for row in pending['assignment_scope']),
        'EPISODE_EXPORT_ASSIGNED_OBSERVATION_BINDING')
    require(pending['pending_scope'] == [{key: row[key] for key in ('id', 'version', 'kind')} for row in pending['observations'] if row['version'] > row['consumed_version']] and all((row['id'] in observations and observations[row['id']]['consumed_version'] >= row['version'] for row in pending['covered_scope'])), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_CONSUMPTION_BINDING')
    lifecycle = closed(value['lifecycle'], ('result', 'acceptance', 'join', 'h0', 'source_terminal_release'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_LIFECYCLE_SHAPE')
    require(lifecycle['result'] == {'status': 'SUCCEEDED', 'return_digest': episode['result_digest']} and lifecycle['acceptance'] == {'status': 'ACCEPTED_EXACT_RESULT', 'digest': episode['acceptance_digest']} and (lifecycle['join'] == {'status': 'JOINED_EVIDENCE_ONLY', 'covered': episode['covered_boundary_versions'], 'pending_consumed': True}), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_RESULT_ACCEPTANCE_JOIN_BINDING')
    h0 = closed(lifecycle['h0'], ('status', 'stage_receipts'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_H0_SHAPE')
    require(h0['status'] in ('NOT_RECORDED', 'RECORDED') and isinstance(h0['stage_receipts'], dict) and (set(h0['stage_receipts']) == (set() if h0['status'] == 'NOT_RECORDED' else {'LOAD', 'USE', 'DISPOSE'})) and all((isinstance(item, str) and re.fullmatch('sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}', item) for item in h0['stage_receipts'].values())) and (len(set(h0['stage_receipts'].values())) == len(h0['stage_receipts'])), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_H0_BINDING')
    release = closed(lifecycle['source_terminal_release'], ('status', 'digest'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_RELEASE_SHAPE')
    require(release['status'] == 'SOURCE_OWNER_VALIDATED' and isinstance(release['digest'], str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', release['digest']), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_RELEASE_BINDING')
    occurrences = closed(value['occurrences'], ('schema', 'observation_id', 'actual_child_identity', 'covered_boundary_versions', 'source_cutoff', 'occurrences', 'authority_ceiling'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_OCCURRENCES_SHAPE')
    require(occurrences['schema'] == 'implementaudit.compaction-selected-occurrences.v1' and occurrences['observation_id'] == episode['observation_id'] and (occurrences['actual_child_identity'] == child) and (occurrences['covered_boundary_versions'] == episode['covered_boundary_versions']) and (occurrences['authority_ceiling'] == 'NONE') and isinstance(occurrences['occurrences'], list) and (3 <= len(occurrences['occurrences']) <= 256), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_OCCURRENCES_BINDING')
    for row in occurrences['occurrences']:
        closed(row, ('population', 'attempt_class', 'semantic', 'observation_id', 'completion', 'records'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_OCCURRENCE_SHAPE')
        require((row['population'], row['attempt_class'], row['semantic']) in {('CURRENT', 'ORIGINAL', semantic) for semantic in ('LOAD', 'EXCHANGE', 'BIND')} | {('PRIOR', 'ORIGINAL', semantic) for semantic in ('LOAD', 'EXCHANGE', 'BIND')} | {('PRIOR', 'RETRY', 'BIND')} and row['completion'] == 'COMPLETED' and isinstance(row['observation_id'], str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', row['observation_id']), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_OCCURRENCE_CLASSIFICATION')
        closed(row['records'], ('call', 'result'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_OCCURRENCE_PAIR')
        require(all((isinstance(row['records'][part], dict) and row['records'][part] for part in ('call', 'result'))), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_OCCURRENCE_COMPLETION')
        for pin in row['records'].values():
            closed(pin, ('path', 'physical', 'role', 'locator', 'timestamp', 'message_or_call_id'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_RECORD_PIN_SHAPE')
            locator = closed(pin['locator'], ('offset', 'bytes', 'sha256', 'embedded_ordinal', 'physical_line'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_RECORD_LOCATOR_SHAPE')
            physical = closed(pin['physical'], ('device', 'inode'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_RECORD_PHYSICAL_SHAPE')
            require(pin['role'] == 'child' and isinstance(pin['path'], str) and (0 < len(pin['path']) <= 4096) and all((type(item) is int and item >= 0 for item in physical.values())) and (type(locator['offset']) is int) and (locator['offset'] >= 0) and (type(locator['bytes']) is int) and (0 < locator['bytes'] <= 256 * 1024) and (type(locator['embedded_ordinal']) is int) and (locator['embedded_ordinal'] >= 1) and (locator['physical_line'] is None or (type(locator['physical_line']) is int and locator['physical_line'] >= 1)) and isinstance(locator['sha256'], str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', locator['sha256']) and all((isinstance(pin[key], str) and pin[key] for key in ('timestamp', 'message_or_call_id'))), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_RECORD_PIN_BINDING')
        before(row['records']['call'], row['records']['result'])
    require({row['semantic'] for row in occurrences['occurrences'] if row['population'] == 'CURRENT'} == {'LOAD', 'EXCHANGE', 'BIND'} and all((row['observation_id'] == episode['observation_id'] for row in occurrences['occurrences'] if row['population'] == 'CURRENT')), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_CURRENT_OCCURRENCES')
    custody = closed(value['custody'], ('candidate', 'qualification', 'episode', 'attestation', 'source_cutoffs'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_CUSTODY_SHAPE')
    for key in ('candidate', 'qualification', 'episode', 'attestation'):
        _episode_export_pin(custody[key])
    require(custody['qualification']['sha256'] == episode['Q_digest'] and custody['episode']['sha256'] == episode['E_digest'], 'EPISODE_EXPORT_CUSTODY_BINDING')
    cuts = closed(custody['source_cutoffs'], ('parent', 'child', 'compaction_cutoff', 'hold_history'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_CUTOFF_SHAPE')
    parent_limit = _episode_export_source(cuts['parent'], 'parent', episode, owner['canonical_opening_digest'])
    child_limit = _episode_export_source(cuts['child'], 'child', episode, owner['canonical_opening_digest'])
    require(cuts['parent']['path'] != cuts['child']['path'] and cuts['parent']['physical'] != cuts['child']['physical'], 'EPISODE_EXPORT_SOURCE_PHYSICAL_ALIAS')
    compact = closed(cuts['compaction_cutoff'], ('path', 'task_id', 'session_id', 'sessions_root', 'physical', 'session_meta_sha256', 'prefix_bytes', 'prefix_sha256', 'provenance', 'native_producer_runtime_equivalence'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_COMPACTION_CUTOFF_SHAPE')
    _episode_export_path(compact['sessions_root'])
    _episode_export_physical(compact['physical'])
    root = compact['sessions_root'].replace('\\', '/').rstrip('/') + '/'
    require(compact['path'] == cuts['parent']['path'] and compact['physical'] == cuts['parent']['physical'] and (compact['task_id'] == compact['session_id'] == parent['thread_id']) and all((cuts[role]['path'].replace('\\', '/').startswith(root) for role in ('parent', 'child'))) and (compact['session_meta_sha256'] == cuts['parent']['metadata']['sha256']) and (type(compact['prefix_bytes']) is int) and (cuts['parent']['metadata']['bytes'] <= compact['prefix_bytes'] <= parent_limit) and isinstance(compact['prefix_sha256'], str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', compact['prefix_sha256']) and (compact['provenance'] == 'HOST_STORE_OWNER_REGISTERED_PHYSICAL_NATIVE_SESSION_PREFIX') and (compact['native_producer_runtime_equivalence'] == 'UNVERIFIED'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_COMPACTION_CUTOFF_BINDING')
    held = closed(cuts['hold_history'], ('path', 'physical', 'prefix_bytes', 'prefix_sha256', 'physical_records', 'history_start_ordinal', 'host_producer_authenticated', 'original_bind'), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_HOLD_CUTOFF_SHAPE')
    _episode_export_physical(held['physical'])
    require(held == occurrences['source_cutoff'] and held['path'] == cuts['child']['path'] and (held['physical'] == cuts['child']['physical']) and (type(held['prefix_bytes']) is int) and (cuts['child']['metadata']['bytes'] < held['prefix_bytes'] <= min(MAX_TOTAL, child_limit)) and isinstance(held['prefix_sha256'], str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', held['prefix_sha256']) and (type(held['physical_records']) is int) and (held['physical_records'] >= 2) and (held['history_start_ordinal'] == 1) and (held['host_producer_authenticated'] is False), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_FIXED_CUTOFF_BINDING')
    current_rows = [row for row in occurrences['occurrences'] if row['population'] == 'CURRENT']
    require(len(current_rows) == 3 and held['original_bind'] == next((row['records'] for row in current_rows if row['semantic'] == 'BIND')), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_ORIGINAL_BIND_CUTOFF')
    offsets = set()
    ordered_records = []
    for row in occurrences['occurrences']:
        for pin in row['records'].values():
            locator = pin['locator']
            require(pin['path'] == held['path'] and pin['physical'] == held['physical'] and (cuts['child']['metadata']['bytes'] <= locator['offset']) and (locator['offset'] + locator['bytes'] <= held['prefix_bytes']) and (locator['embedded_ordinal'] < held['physical_records']) and (locator['physical_line'] in (None, locator['embedded_ordinal'] + 1)) and (locator['offset'] not in offsets), 'EPISODE_EXPORT_OCCURRENCE_SOURCE_RANGE_OR_IDENTITY')
            offsets.add(locator['offset'])
            ordered_records.append(pin)
    ordered_records.sort(key=lambda pin: pin['locator']['offset'])
    for prior, current in zip(ordered_records, ordered_records[1:]):
        before(prior, current)
        require(prior['locator']['embedded_ordinal'] < current['locator']['embedded_ordinal'],
            'EPISODE_EXPORT_RECORD_ORDINAL_ORDER')
    return value


# Ordinary review receiving is a separate contract. No compaction assignment,
# boundary coverage, pending consumption or full H0 lifecycle is implied.
ORDINARY_PROFILE = 'codex-app-ordinary-review-v1'
ORDINARY_EXPORT_SCHEMA = 'implementaudit.ordinary-episode-export.v1'
ORDINARY_ABSENCES = ('ORDINARY_SELECTION_UNBOUND', 'CANONICAL_REVIEW_ABSENT',
                    'CHILD_RETURN_ABSENT', 'PARENT_ACCEPTANCE_ABSENT',
                    'REVIEW_EVIDENCE_ABSENT', 'RECEIVER_EXECUTION_ABSENT', 'RECEIVING_EVIDENCE_ABSENT')
ORDINARY_LIFECYCLE = {'OPEN': 'CANONICAL', 'RETURN': 'CANONICAL', 'RECONCILE': 'CANONICAL',
                      'LOAD': 'UNVERIFIED', 'USE': 'UNVERIFIED', 'DISPOSE': 'UNVERIFIED',
                      'parent_complete': False}


def _ordinary_hash(value):
    return digest(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'),
                             ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8'))


def _ordinary_sha(value, prefixed=False):
    require(type(value) is str and re.fullmatch(('sha256:' if prefixed else '') + '[0-9a-f]{64}', value),
            'ORDINARY_DIGEST')


def _ordinary_text(value):
    require(type(value) is str and 0 < len(value) <= 4096 and all(ord(c) >= 32 for c in value),
            'ORDINARY_TEXT')


def _ordinary_wire(value):
    import base64
    closed(value, ('bytes', 'digest', 'bytes_b64'), 'ORDINARY_WIRE_FIELDS')
    require(type(value['bytes']) is int and 0 < value['bytes'] <= 1024 * 1024 and
            type(value['bytes_b64']) is str and len(value['bytes_b64']) <= 1400000, 'ORDINARY_WIRE_BOUND')
    _ordinary_sha(value['digest'], True)
    raw = base64.b64decode(value['bytes_b64'], validate=True)
    require(len(raw) == value['bytes'] and 'sha256:' + digest(raw) == value['digest'], 'ORDINARY_WIRE_DIGEST')
    result = json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8', 'strict'), object_pairs_hook=unique)
    require(type(result) is dict, 'ORDINARY_WIRE_OBJECT')
    return result


def _ordinary_pin(value):
    closed(value, ('path', 'bytes', 'sha256'), 'ORDINARY_ARTIFACT_PIN')
    _episode_export_path(value['path'])
    require(type(value['bytes']) is int and 0 < value['bytes'] <= MAX_TOTAL, 'ORDINARY_ARTIFACT_BOUND')
    _ordinary_sha(value['sha256'])


def _ordinary_record(pin, sources, role=None):
    closed(pin, ('path', 'physical', 'role', 'locator', 'timestamp', 'message_or_call_id'), 'ORDINARY_RECORD_PIN')
    require(pin['role'] in sources and (role is None or pin['role'] == role), 'ORDINARY_RECORD_ROLE')
    source = sources[pin['role']]
    require(pin['path'] == source['path'] and pin['physical'] == source['physical'], 'ORDINARY_RECORD_SOURCE')
    loc = closed(pin['locator'], ('offset', 'bytes', 'sha256', 'embedded_ordinal', 'physical_line'), 'ORDINARY_LOCATOR')
    require(type(loc['offset']) is int and loc['offset'] >= source['metadata']['bytes'] and
            type(loc['bytes']) is int and 0 < loc['bytes'] <= MAX_RECORD and
            loc['offset'] + loc['bytes'] <= source['cutoff'] and
            type(loc['embedded_ordinal']) is int and loc['embedded_ordinal'] >= 1 and
            (loc['physical_line'] is None or type(loc['physical_line']) is int and loc['physical_line'] >= 2),
            'ORDINARY_RECORD_RANGE')
    _ordinary_sha(loc['sha256'])
    _ordinary_text(pin['timestamp']); _ordinary_text(pin['message_or_call_id'])


def ordinary_receiver_value_v1(owner, result, acceptance):
    return {'schema': 'implementaudit.ordinary-receiver-result.v1', 'status': 'VALIDATED',
            'opening_digest': owner['opening']['opening_digest'],
            'packet_digest': result['packet']['digest'], 'return_digest': result['return']['digest'],
            'acceptance_digest': acceptance['decision']['digest'],
            'members_digest': _ordinary_hash(result['members']), 'scope': owner['scope'],
            'actual_child_identity': result['actual_child_identity'], 'authority_ceiling': 'NONE'}


def ordinary_join_value_v1(owner, result, acceptance, receiving):
    return {'schema': 'implementaudit.ordinary-join-acceptance.v1',
            'opening_digest': owner['opening']['opening_digest'], 'return_digest': result['return']['digest'],
            'acceptance_digest': acceptance['decision']['digest'],
            'execution_receipt_ref': receiving['process']['ref'],
            'execution_receipt_digest': receiving['process']['wire']['digest'],
            'receiver_evidence_digest': receiving['result']['evidence_digest'],
            'node': receiving['result']['node'], 'consumer': receiving['join']['consumer'],
            'graph_digest': receiving['join']['graph_digest'], 'dispatch_id': receiving['dispatch']['dispatch_id'],
            'join_digest': _ordinary_hash(receiving['join']), 'scope': owner['scope'],
            'decision_before': 'RECEIVING_UNVERIFIED', 'decision_after': 'SCOPED_RESULT_RECEIVED',
            'authority_ceiling': 'NONE'}


def ordinary_export_unavailable_v1(reason):
    value = {'schema': ORDINARY_EXPORT_SCHEMA, 'status': 'UNAVAILABLE', 'reason_code': reason,
             **{key: None for key in ('owner', 'result', 'acceptance', 'receiving', 'lifecycle', 'occurrences', 'custody')},
             'authority_ceiling': 'NONE'}
    return validate_ordinary_episode_export_v1({**value, 'export_digest': _ordinary_hash(value)})


def _ordinary_public_json_v1(body):
    # The native commentary carrier may retain one LF after the fence. Parse
    # that view only: original body bytes, native hashes and locators stay exact.
    require(type(body) is str and body.startswith('```json\n'), 'ORDINARY_PUBLIC_BODY')
    view = body[:-1] if body.endswith('\n') else body
    require(view.endswith('\n```'), 'ORDINARY_PUBLIC_BODY')
    return json.loads(view[8:-4], object_pairs_hook=unique)


def _validate_ordinary_episode_v1(value, *, review_only=False):
    """Pure closed-schema consistency check; never authenticates caller bytes."""
    raw = json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8')
    require(len(raw) <= 8 * 1024 * 1024, 'ORDINARY_EXPORT_BOUND')
    closed(value, ('schema', 'status', 'reason_code', 'owner', 'result', 'acceptance', 'receiving',
                   'lifecycle', 'occurrences', 'custody', 'authority_ceiling', 'export_digest'), 'ORDINARY_EXPORT_FIELDS')
    require(value['schema'] == ORDINARY_EXPORT_SCHEMA and value['authority_ceiling'] == 'NONE' and
            value['export_digest'] == _ordinary_hash({k: v for k, v in value.items() if k != 'export_digest'}),
            'ORDINARY_EXPORT_IDENTITY')
    if value['status'] == 'UNAVAILABLE':
        require(value['reason_code'] in ORDINARY_ABSENCES and all(value[k] is None for k in
                ('owner', 'result', 'acceptance', 'receiving', 'lifecycle', 'occurrences', 'custody')), 'ORDINARY_ABSENCE')
        return value
    require(value['status'] == 'AVAILABLE' and value['reason_code'] is None, 'ORDINARY_EXPORT_STATUS')
    owner = closed(value['owner'], ('profile_id', 'issuer_id', 'policy_digest', 'code_pins',
                    'canonical_route', 'host_and_scope', 'opening', 'scope'), 'ORDINARY_OWNER')
    require(owner['profile_id'] == ORDINARY_PROFILE and owner['issuer_id'] == 'codex-app-canonical-ordinary-public-v1',
            'ORDINARY_OWNER_PROFILE')
    route, host = owner['canonical_route'], owner['host_and_scope']
    result = closed(value['result'], ('packet', 'return', 'actual_child_identity', 'members', 'final'), 'ORDINARY_RESULT')
    child = closed(result['actual_child_identity'], ('thread_id', 'parent_thread_id', 'agent_path'), 'ORDINARY_CHILD')
    for item in child.values(): _ordinary_text(item)
    episode = {'parent_identity': {'thread_id': child['parent_thread_id']}}
    _episode_export_route_binding(owner, episode)
    require(route['route_state'] == 'SATISFIED', 'ORDINARY_ROUTE_NOT_ACCEPTED')
    opening = closed(owner['opening'], ('schema', 'route_current', 'open_record_oid', 'open_record_identity',
        'logical_task', 'selected_child_role', 'selected_child_target', 'packet_pin', 'skill_pin', 'host_and_scope',
        'canonical_route_currentness', 'authority_ceiling', 'opening_digest', 'binding_digest'), 'ORDINARY_OPENING')
    require(opening['schema'] == 'implementaudit.r0033-current-episode-binding.v1' and
            opening['route_current'] == route and opening['host_and_scope'] == host and
            opening['selected_child_role'] == 'audit-assess' and opening['selected_child_target'] == 'independently assess the exact immutable review packet' and
            opening['canonical_route_currentness'] == 'VALIDATED_AT_READ' and opening['authority_ceiling'] == 'NONE' and
            re.fullmatch('[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,127}', opening['logical_task']) is not None,
            'ORDINARY_OPENING_BINDING')
    opening_body = {k: opening[k] for k in ('open_record_oid', 'open_record_identity', 'logical_task',
                    'selected_child_role', 'selected_child_target', 'packet_pin', 'skill_pin', 'host_and_scope')}
    require(opening['opening_digest'] == 'sha256:' + _ordinary_hash(opening_body) and
            opening['binding_digest'] == 'sha256:' + _ordinary_hash({k: v for k, v in opening.items() if k not in ('opening_digest', 'binding_digest')}),
            'ORDINARY_OPENING_DIGEST')
    require(type(opening['open_record_oid']) is str and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}(?:[0-9a-f]{24})?', opening['open_record_oid']), 'ORDINARY_OPEN_OID')
    _ordinary_sha(opening['open_record_identity'], True)
    require(child['thread_id'] != child['parent_thread_id'] and child['parent_thread_id'] == host['host_session_id'], 'ORDINARY_CHILD_PARENT')
    scope = closed(owner['scope'], ('identity', 'digest'), 'ORDINARY_SCOPE')
    _ordinary_text(scope['identity'])
    require(scope['digest'] == 'sha256:' + _ordinary_hash({'identity': scope['identity']}), 'ORDINARY_SCOPE_DIGEST')
    custody = closed(value['custody'], ('policy', 'sources', 'review_evidence', 'receiving_evidence', 'public_records'), 'ORDINARY_CUSTODY')
    policy = closed(custody['policy'], ('schema', 'profile_id', 'selection_pin', 'instance_selection', 'provider',
        'code_pins', 'receiver_argv', 'receiver_node', 'consumer', 'artifact_root', 'root_thread_id', 'root_agent_path'), 'ORDINARY_POLICY')
    require(policy['schema'] == 'implementaudit.ordinary-native-policy.v1' and policy['profile_id'] == ORDINARY_PROFILE and
            policy['instance_selection'] == 'EXACT_ROOT_EXECUTION_ANCESTRY' and
            owner['policy_digest'] == _ordinary_hash(policy) and owner['code_pins'] == policy['code_pins'] and
            child['parent_thread_id'] == policy['root_thread_id'] and
            child['agent_path'] == policy['root_agent_path'] + '/' + opening['logical_task'], 'ORDINARY_POLICY_BINDING')
    pins = owner['code_pins']
    required = {'implementaudit/scripts/' + name for name in ('route-transaction.py', 'compaction-audit-pending.py',
        'compaction-result-observation.py', 'compaction-source-owner-codex-app.py', 'bounded_source_owner.py',
        'bounded_native_reader.py', 'bounded_file_custody.py', 'codex-recovery-native-reader.py',
        'host-session-binding.py', 'compile-work-graph.py', 'claim-run.sh', 'validate-run-root.sh', 'route_request_policy.py')}
    required.update(('implementaudit/SKILL.md', 'audit-assess/SKILL.md',
                     'implementaudit/references/child-agents.md', 'implementaudit/references/continuity.md'))
    require(type(pins) is dict and set(pins) == required, 'ORDINARY_CODE_PIN_POPULATION')
    for pin in pins.values(): _ordinary_sha(pin)
    skill = closed(opening['skill_pin'], ('identity', 'bytes', 'digest'), 'ORDINARY_SKILL_PIN')
    _episode_export_path(skill['identity'])
    require(skill['identity'].replace('\\', '/').endswith('/audit-assess/SKILL.md') and type(skill['bytes']) is int and
            0 < skill['bytes'] <= 1024 * 1024 and skill['digest'] == 'sha256:' + pins['audit-assess/SKILL.md'], 'ORDINARY_SKILL_SOURCE')
    _ordinary_pin(policy['selection_pin']); _episode_export_path(policy['artifact_root'])
    require(type(policy['provider']) is dict and set(policy['provider']) ==
            {'native_executable', 'desktop_executable', 'desktop_asar', 'config_file', 'python_executable'}, 'ORDINARY_PROVIDER')
    for pin in policy['provider'].values():
        closed(pin, ('path', 'bytes', 'sha256'), 'ORDINARY_PROVIDER_PIN')
        _episode_export_path(pin['path']); _ordinary_sha(pin['sha256'])
        require(type(pin['bytes']) is int and 0 < pin['bytes'] <= 1024 * 1024 * 1024, 'ORDINARY_PROVIDER_BOUND')
    require(type(policy['receiver_argv']) is list and len(policy['receiver_argv']) == 6 and
            policy['receiver_argv'][0] == policy['provider']['python_executable']['path'] and
            policy['receiver_argv'][1:4] == ['-I', '-S', '-B'] and policy['receiver_argv'][5] == '--ordinary-receiver' and
            policy['receiver_argv'][4].replace('\\', '/').endswith('/compaction-source-owner-codex-app.py'), 'ORDINARY_RECEIVER_ARGV')
    _episode_export_path(policy['receiver_argv'][4])
    for k in ('receiver_node', 'consumer'): _ordinary_text(policy[k])
    packet = _ordinary_wire(result['packet']); returned = _ordinary_wire(result['return'])
    require(opening['packet_pin'] == {k: result['packet'][k] for k in ('bytes', 'digest')}, 'ORDINARY_PACKET_PIN')
    closed(packet, ('schema', 'obligation_id', 'route_transaction_id', 'target_identity', 'source_event'), 'ORDINARY_PACKET')
    closed(returned, ('schema', 'obligation_id', 'route_transaction_id', 'packet_digest', 'status', 'payload'), 'ORDINARY_RETURN')
    require(packet['schema'] == 'implementaudit.route-packet.v1' and packet['target_identity'] == 'audit-assess' and
            returned['schema'] == 'implementaudit.child-return.v1' and returned['status'] == 'RETURNED' and
            returned['packet_digest'] == result['packet']['digest'] and
            all(packet[k] == returned[k] == route[k] for k in ('obligation_id', 'route_transaction_id')), 'ORDINARY_RETURN_BINDING')
    event = closed(packet['source_event'], ('schema', 'source_identity', 'provenance', 'body', 'kind', 'reactivation'), 'ORDINARY_SOURCE_EVENT')
    provenance = closed(event['provenance'], ('schema', 'event_id', 'host_correlation_id'), 'ORDINARY_SOURCE_PROVENANCE')
    reactivate = closed(event['reactivation'], ('reopen', 'target_changed', 'invalidating_evidence'), 'ORDINARY_REACTIVATION')
    require(event['schema'] == 'implementaudit.source-event.v1' and type(event['source_identity']) is str and
            re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,255}', event['source_identity']) and
            provenance['schema'] == 'implementaudit.source-event-provenance.v1' and provenance['event_id'] == event['source_identity'] and
            event['kind'] in ('one-shot-action', 'standing-constraint') and all(type(item) is bool for item in reactivate.values()), 'ORDINARY_SOURCE_EVENT_BINDING')
    _ordinary_sha(provenance['host_correlation_id'], True)
    require(type(event['body']) is str and 0 < len(event['body'].encode()) <= 100000, 'ORDINARY_MISSION_BOUND')
    mission = json.loads(event['body'], object_pairs_hook=unique)
    closed(mission, ('schema', 'policy_digest', 'scope', 'mission', 'authority_ceiling'), 'ORDINARY_MISSION')
    require(mission['schema'] == 'implementaudit.ordinary-review-mission.v1' and mission['policy_digest'] == owner['policy_digest'] and
            mission['scope'] == scope and mission['authority_ceiling'] == 'NONE', 'ORDINARY_PROSPECTIVE_POLICY_BINDING')
    _ordinary_text(mission['mission'])
    payload = closed(returned['payload'], ('schema', 'verdict', 'scope', 'summary', 'members', 'authority_ceiling'), 'ORDINARY_PAYLOAD')
    require(payload['schema'] == 'implementaudit.ordinary-review-payload.v1' and payload['verdict'] in ('PASS', 'FAIL', 'NONVERDICT') and
            payload['scope'] == scope and payload['authority_ceiling'] == 'NONE', 'ORDINARY_PAYLOAD_BINDING')
    _ordinary_text(payload['summary'])
    require(type(result['members']) is list and 1 <= len(result['members']) <= 32 and
            payload['members'] == [m['pin'] for m in result['members']], 'ORDINARY_MEMBER_POPULATION')
    seen_paths, seen_physical, total = set(), set(), result['return']['bytes']
    root = policy['artifact_root'].replace('\\', '/').rstrip('/') + '/'
    for member in result['members']:
        closed(member, ('pin', 'physical'), 'ORDINARY_MEMBER')
        _ordinary_pin(member['pin']); _episode_export_physical(member['physical'])
        path = member['pin']['path'].replace('\\', '/')
        physical_id = tuple(member['physical'][k] for k in ('device', 'inode'))
        require(path.startswith(root) and path not in seen_paths and physical_id not in seen_physical, 'ORDINARY_MEMBER_CUSTODY')
        seen_paths.add(path); seen_physical.add(physical_id); total += member['pin']['bytes']
    require(total <= MAX_TOTAL, 'ORDINARY_MEMBER_TOTAL')
    acceptance = closed(value['acceptance'], ('decision', 'record'), 'ORDINARY_ACCEPTANCE')
    decision = _ordinary_wire(acceptance['decision'])
    closed(decision, ('schema', 'obligation_id', 'route_transaction_id', 'return_digest', 'outcome', 'reason'), 'ORDINARY_DECISION')
    require(decision['schema'] == 'implementaudit.governor-route-decision.v1' and decision['outcome'] == 'SATISFIED' and
            decision['return_digest'] == result['return']['digest'] and
            all(decision[k] == route[k] for k in ('obligation_id', 'route_transaction_id')), 'ORDINARY_ACCEPTANCE_BINDING')
    _ordinary_text(decision['reason'])
    require(value['lifecycle'] == ORDINARY_LIFECYCLE, 'ORDINARY_STAGE_PROMOTION')
    sources = closed(custody['sources'], ('parent', 'child'), 'ORDINARY_SOURCES')
    for role, source in sources.items():
        closed(source, ('path', 'physical', 'metadata', 'thread_id', 'cutoff'), 'ORDINARY_SOURCE')
        _episode_export_path(source['path']); _episode_export_physical(source['physical'])
        _episode_export_locator(source['metadata'])
        require(source['metadata']['offset'] == 0 and source['metadata']['embedded_ordinal'] == 0 and
                type(source['cutoff']) is int and source['metadata']['bytes'] < source['cutoff'] <= MAX_TOTAL * MAX_RECORDS and
                source['thread_id'] == (child['thread_id'] if role == 'child' else child['parent_thread_id']), 'ORDINARY_SOURCE_BINDING')
    require(sources['parent']['path'] != sources['child']['path'] and sources['parent']['physical'] != sources['child']['physical'], 'ORDINARY_SOURCE_ALIAS')
    occurrences = closed(value['occurrences'], ('scope', 'history', 'open', 'spawn', 'activation'), 'ORDINARY_OCCURRENCES')
    require(occurrences['scope'] == 'SELECTED_FRESH_CHILD_ONLY' and occurrences['history'] == 'UNEXAMINED_OUTSIDE_SELECTED_RECORDS', 'ORDINARY_HISTORY_PROMOTION')
    spawn = closed(occurrences['spawn'], ('call', 'output', 'task_name', 'fork_turns'), 'ORDINARY_SPAWN')
    require(spawn['task_name'] == opening['logical_task'] and spawn['fork_turns'] == 'none', 'ORDINARY_FRESH_CHILD')
    for pin in (occurrences['open'], spawn['call'], spawn['output']): _ordinary_record(pin, sources, 'parent')
    _ordinary_record(occurrences['activation'], sources, 'child')
    require(occurrences['activation']['locator']['offset'] == sources['child']['metadata']['bytes'] and
            occurrences['activation']['locator']['embedded_ordinal'] == 1, 'ORDINARY_ACTIVATION')
    before(occurrences['open'], spawn['call']); before(spawn['call'], spawn['output']); before(spawn['output'], occurrences['activation'])
    _ordinary_record(result['final'], sources, 'child'); _ordinary_record(acceptance['record'], sources, 'parent')
    before(occurrences['activation'], result['final']); before(result['final'], acceptance['record'])
    if review_only:
        records = custody['public_records']
        require(type(records) is list and len(records) == 3, 'ORDINARY_REVIEW_PUBLIC_POPULATION')
        for record, pin, expected, phase in ((records[0], occurrences['open'], None, 'commentary'),
            (records[1], result['final'], returned, 'final_answer'), (records[2], acceptance['record'], decision, 'commentary')):
            closed(record, ('pin', 'message_id', 'turn_id', 'revision', 'phase', 'body', 'body_sha256'), 'ORDINARY_PUBLIC_RECORD')
            require(record['pin'] == pin and record['message_id'] == pin['message_or_call_id'] and record['phase'] == phase and
                    type(record['body']) is str and 0 < len(record['body'].encode()) <= MAX_RECORD and
                    digest(record['body'].encode()) == record['body_sha256'], 'ORDINARY_PUBLIC_BINDING')
            if expected is not None:

    expected_ref = 'refs/implementaudit/ordinary-receivers/' + owner['canonical_route']['controller_id'] + '/' + owner['opening']['opening_digest'].removeprefix('sha256:')

"""Finite source-free child for recorder instrumentation evidence only."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
store = Path(sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--store') + 1])
assert store.is_absolute() and store.is_relative_to(ROOT / 'runs')
assert store.resolve(strict=True) == store
request = json.load(sys.stdin)
mode = request['mode']
assert mode in ('ordinary', 'oversized_stdout', 'after_snapshot', 'nonzero', 'timeout')
value = {'authority': 'NONE', 'canonical_currentness': False,
         'recovery_authority': False, 'epoch_authority': False,
         'effect_authority': False, 'independent_children': 'UNCHANGED',
         'actual_child_result_consumer': 'UNQUALIFIED',
         'same_failed_scope_retry': 'CONDITIONAL_UNQUALIFIED'}
if mode == 'oversized_stdout':
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(b'X' * 262145)
else:
    if mode == 'after_snapshot':
        with (store / 'oversized.bin').open('xb') as stream:
            stream.write(b'S' * 262145)
    print(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
if mode == 'timeout':
    time.sleep(5)
raise SystemExit(7 if mode == 'nonzero' else 0)

"""Existing native reader: bounded nonprotected public entry projection."""
import hashlib
import os
import pathlib

class Refusal(ValueError):
    pass

def native_read_nonprotected(selection, methods, *, child_id=None, protocol_helper):
    """Current bounded public transport, called only by the fixed source owner.

    This entry does not choose or authenticate a policy. Its owner supplies the
    already selected helper; P/Q/E still govern whether any result is admitted.
    The legacy native_read override/provider guard is unchanged.
    """
    expected = selection['runtime_helpers']['bounded_native_reader.py']
    path = pathlib.Path(protocol_helper.__file__)
    if path.name != 'bounded_native_reader.py' or str(path) != expected['path']:
        raise Refusal('nonprotected protocol helper path differs')
    with protocol_helper.custody.held_file(path, allow_append=False) as stream:
        before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        if before.st_nlink != 1 or before.st_size != expected['bytes'] or before.st_size > 256 * 1024:
            raise Refusal('nonprotected protocol helper bound differs')
        raw = stream.read(before.st_size)
        if len(raw) != before.st_size or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != expected['sha256']:
            raise Refusal('nonprotected protocol helper pin differs')
        # protocol_helper.probe holds the actual native executable immutably
        # from byte pin through launch, protocol drainage and terminal readback.
        return protocol_helper.probe(selection, methods, child_id=child_id)

# Independent raw-evidence subreview

**Verdict: PASS for the stated finite retained-evidence scope.** No blocking inconsistency was found between the raw captures, recorded commands, frozen expectations, source identities, and receiver tuple. This is an ordinary engineering subreview with no formal native audit-assessor origin or authority.

## Sealed subject

- Packet: `[OWNER_G8_WORKSPACE]/evidence/integration38-pending-receiving/REVIEW-PACKET-v2.zip`
- Bytes: `1764564`
- SHA-256: `7b9669fb7f711a900eadd70bf6dea845daebeebd92e633baef22cbfd4f601804`

All 265 payload files match the exact manifest membership, lengths, SHA-256 hashes, and ZIP file modes. The archive has the manifest plus those 265 files. The independent check script performed 821 assertions over retained content and produced no failures. It read only this sealed packet and wrote its own check/report files; it did not import or execute packet code or replay any subject CLI.

## Raw outcomes and preserved state

| Retained commands | Independent finding |
|---|---|
| Baseline 1–3 | Init and constructed binding succeed; binding explicitly reports `host_activation_proven=false`. Resume creates a real unresolved observation at version 1, consumed version 0, with held decisions and no assignment. |
| Baseline 4 | The only fixture state change is consumed version 0 → 2. Status returns exit 0, `NO_PENDING_AUDIT`, and both hold booleans false. The outer driver retains FAIL / exit 1. |
| Candidate 4, 9, 12 | Fresh status, exact restoration, and status after receiving refusals return the original held decision and exact original pending bytes. |
| Candidate 5 | Duplicate top-level `observations` is present in the raw fixture; exit 2 / `PENDING_OPERATION_REFUSED` / `DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY`, without a decision. |
| Candidate 6 | The recorded pending object is a symlink to the absent-fixture target. Exit 2 refuses the unsafe regular-file boundary, preserving the link and its target. |
| Candidate 7–8 | Status and resume both receive the same retained version 1 / consumed version 2 bytes and both return exit 2 / `PENDING_OBSERVATION_COUNTERS`, without a decision or successor write. |
| Candidate 10–11 | The exact first guards are `NONPROTECTED_PROJECTION_PROFILE_REQUIRED` and `NONPROTECTED_SELECTED_ROOT_REQUIRED`; neither response creates an assignment. |
| Candidate 13–14 | One later resume increments only revision 1 → 2 and unresolved observation version 1 → 2; consumed remains 0, source remains null, assignments remain empty. Fresh status returns the exact same successor decision. |

The 4 baseline and 14 candidate records agree with all 54 retained stdin/stdout/stderr files, including raw lengths and hashes. All child stderr streams are empty, recorded processes finish within their recorded 15-second limits, and invocation ordering fits the outer capture intervals. The command operands identify the appropriate baseline/candidate source projection and private fixture store. Outer stdout parses to the corresponding retained RESULT, and outer stderr/hash/exit-code records agree.

All six candidate refusals preserve the entire captured store snapshot before and after. The four held/read controls also preserve it. Every regular-file snapshot hash resolves to retained raw bytes: 148 cumulative regular-file entries across before/after snapshots, not 148 distinct files. Per-command raw pending copies match their snapshot hashes. Final fixture regular-file membership and bytes match the final snapshots. Inter-command state continuity agrees except at the explicitly declared fixture edits and the successful successor write.

## Oracle and exact source subject

Baseline and candidate oracle JSON differ only in phase and the pending source hash. Both results and the prospective input record bind the same retained driver, SHA-256 `7e30c1b062f2e8ed71099b1281cf421cf72bf5d0d3fd3f541b5c9befccf2e433`. The prospective baseline-source and public-ref digests match their retained inputs. The driver writes the explicit oracle before the first child invocation; the counter refusal expectations are fixed constants. No relaxed oracle is present. This verifies content and program-order consistency; it does not supply an independently trusted pre-execution timestamp.

The executed subject is the disposable source projection over combined `e4fc52757d3082d12f17137600034c5ca008e82b`: 13 selected current R39 native peers plus 3 route peers. Its reconstructed 98-file population matches every retained PROJECTION-IDENTITY entry. The candidate native population differs from baseline only in the pending peer and its manifest. Removing the `load()` text from each pending file leaves identical bytes, and the candidate `load()` exactly matches the retained R33 reference body, SHA-256 `13c46a875f92f0084082338c8a0f4bfcdf53b347ac44b9744a7097a6e229ed96`. The executing four owner pins match the projected bytes; all three native selection constants remain null. This does not qualify unchanged canonical shipped runtime or native activation.

## One receiver invocation

The retained tuple invocation exits 0 with empty stderr; its raw stdout equals `tuple-RESULT.json` and the driver hash matches `qualify_tuple.py`. Static, independent AST inspection confirms six historical source/refusal pairs are preserved and exactly one pair is added. The old dictionary rejects the new four-owner source identity, the new dictionary maps it to `source-sha256:9b5faf290e08d3df77b15d5e5301a3760c4e599d16719cf8f72e1768522ea691` with the exact reservation reason `NONPROTECTED_PROJECTION_PROFILE_REQUIRED`, and the changed-pending-digest identity is absent. Removing the one added entry makes the entire before/after test AST identical. These findings agree with the four checks reported by the one receiver invocation.

## Evidence anchors

All paths below are members of the sealed ZIP. Detailed per-command hashes and all checks are retained in `CHECKS.json`.

| ZIP member | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `evidence/integration38-pending-receiving/baseline/commands.jsonl` | `1456fec7ff48ee78a24e28a70438d64844a53a460bf650aee01cfa02f28a355d` |

## Limits and interpretation

- Retained author-produced process records are internally verified; no independent process attestation or rerun was performed.
- Oracle text, input hashes and driver order are consistent with freezing before dispatch; the sealed packet supplies no independent trusted pre-execution timestamp.
- Snapshot equality covers the recorded store tree, paths, kinds, mode, inode, device, sizes, mtime, ctime, regular-file bytes by hash and symlink target. It does not cover atime, ownership, ACLs, xattrs, external trees, power-loss durability or hostile concurrent writers.
- Source qualification is the disposable projection of combined e4fc core plus 13 current R39 native peers and 3 route peers. It is not unchanged canonical shipped runtime, installed/native activation, selection or native lifecycle/consumption qualification.
- The receiver invocation verifies source/refusal tuple acceptance and AST preservation. It does not replay the historical durability bank or close original populations.
- `composition.json` retains `actual_qualification: NOT_YET_RUN` as a construction-stage record. The later raw command records and final RESULT files carry the observed runtime outcomes; the construction field must not be presented as the final verdict.

No further subject execution was necessary to resolve the finite retained-evidence questions. The earlier excluded platform-blocked R37 task, native actors, banks, protected state, root worktrees, network, and installed host were not inspected or exercised.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Sealed finite private receiver launcher; no authorization is conferred.

Linux subreaping is confined to this launcher process and its one owned bank
session. It records actual launches and contains/reaps surviving descendants.
Receipt storage/power-loss and unknown-Popen PID recovery are not guaranteed.
"""
import ctypes
import errno
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import resource
import signal
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import traceback

ROOT = Path('[TASK_WORKSPACE]/pending-composition')
COMMANDS_SHA256 = '7c1ed11d05edca51be75b3505505102dd4acfde582bdbe309e111d8e99c04c78'
DEPENDENCIES_SHA256 = 'b886eef6dfdbaa600b2a9a56d36e5e3b30f8b892c53cdd2f64f63bc3865f190e'


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise AssertionError(message)


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def checked_file(path, expected, maximum):
    info = path.lstat()
    require(path.resolve(strict=True) == path and stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)
            and info.st_nlink == 1 and info.st_size <= maximum,
            'nonphysical or oversized launch input: ' + str(path))
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    require(len(raw) == info.st_size and sha(raw) == expected,
            'launch input identity mismatch: ' + str(path))
    return raw


def put_json(path, value):
    with path.open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        stream.write('\n')


def check_runtime(dependencies):
    for item in dependencies['runtime_files']:
        checked_file(Path(item['path']), item['sha256'], item['bytes'])
    require(os.uname().release == dependencies['kernel']
            and os.uname().machine == dependencies['machine'],
            'recorded runtime platform changed')
    return {'files': len(dependencies['runtime_files']), 'all_hashes_match': True,
            'manifest_sha256': DEPENDENCIES_SHA256}


def enable_subreaper():
    require(sys.platform == 'linux', 'selected containment requires Linux')
    libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    old = ctypes.c_int()
    if libc.prctl(37, ctypes.byref(old), 0, 0, 0) != 0:
        raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), 'PR_GET_CHILD_SUBREAPER failed')
    if libc.prctl(36, 1, 0, 0, 0) != 0:
        raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), 'PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER failed')
    actual = ctypes.c_int()
    if libc.prctl(37, ctypes.byref(actual), 0, 0, 0) != 0:
        raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), 'PR_GET_CHILD_SUBREAPER verification failed')
    require(actual.value == 1, 'subreaper not established')
    return {'method': 'Linux prctl PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER',
            'previous': old.value, 'actual': actual.value,
            'scope': 'this launcher process; one owned new bank session'}


def group_exists(pgid):
    try:
        os.killpg(pgid, 0)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        return False
    return True


def reap_adopted(pgid, record):
    """Reap only children in this launcher's known bank group, never other groups."""
    records = record.setdefault('adopted_descendant_reaps', [])
    while True:
        try:
            pid, status = os.waitpid(-pgid, os.WNOHANG)
        except ChildProcessError:
            return
        except InterruptedError:
            continue
        if pid == 0:
            return
        records.append({'pid': pid, 'wait_status': status,
                        'exit': os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status), 'reaped': True})


def contain_group(child, grace, record):
    """Bounded TERM/KILL and actual waits. Incomplete containment remains failure."""
    pgid = child.pid
    events = record.setdefault('termination_events', [])
    for sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGKILL):
        try:
            os.killpg(pgid, sig)
            events.append({'signal': signal.Signals(sig).name, 'group': pgid, 'sent': True})
        except ProcessLookupError:
            events.append({'signal': signal.Signals(sig).name, 'group': pgid, 'sent': False})
        deadline = time.monotonic() + grace
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            # Let Popen reap its direct child before waitpid can select the group.
            if child.poll() is not None:
                record['driver_reaped'] = True
                record['exit'] = child.returncode
                reap_adopted(pgid, record)
                if not group_exists(pgid):
                    record['residual_process_group_after_containment'] = False
                    return
            time.sleep(0.02)
    record['driver_reaped'] = child.poll() is not None
    if record['driver_reaped']:
        record['exit'] = child.returncode
        reap_adopted(pgid, record)
    record['residual_process_group_after_containment'] = group_exists(pgid)
    require(record['driver_reaped'] and not record['residual_process_group_after_containment'],
            'bank group containment/reaping incomplete')


def main():
    require(Path(__file__).resolve() == ROOT / 'run_bounded.py'
            and ROOT.resolve(strict=True) == ROOT, 'launcher root/path moved')
    require(os.name == 'posix' and len(sys.argv) == 2
            and sys.argv[1] in ('counter', 'custody'),
            'usage: exact launcher counter|custody on Linux')
    manifest = json.loads(checked_file(ROOT / 'EXECUTION_COMMANDS.json', COMMANDS_SHA256, 65536))
    dependencies = json.loads(checked_file(ROOT / 'DEPENDENCIES.json', DEPENDENCIES_SHA256, 1024 * 1024))
    runtime_before = check_runtime(dependencies)
    bank = next(b for b in manifest['banks'] if b['name'] == sys.argv[1])
    interpreter = manifest['interpreter']
    require(Path(sys.executable).resolve(strict=True) == Path(interpreter['path']),
            'interpreter path changed')
    checked_file(Path(interpreter['path']), interpreter['sha256'], interpreter['bytes'])
    checked_file(Path(bank['driver']['path']), bank['driver']['sha256'], 1024 * 1024)
    require(bank['command'][:4] == [interpreter['path'], '-I', '-S', '-B']
            and bank['command'][4] == bank['driver']['path'] and bank['cwd'] == str(ROOT),
            'sealed command relationship changed')
    for text in bank['required_absent_before_launch']:
        path = Path(text)
        require(path.is_relative_to(ROOT) and path.resolve(strict=False) == path
                and not os.path.lexists(path), 'output reuse or alias refused: ' + text)
    evidence = Path(bank['launch_evidence'])
    require(evidence.is_relative_to(ROOT) and evidence.resolve(strict=False) == evidence
            and not os.path.lexists(evidence), 'launch receipt already exists or aliased')
    subreaper = enable_subreaper()
    evidence.mkdir(parents=True)
    (evidence / 'tmp').mkdir()
    env = {'PATH': '/usr/bin:/bin', 'LANG': 'C', 'LC_ALL': 'C',
           'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1', 'TMPDIR': str(evidence / 'tmp')}
    limits = manifest['limits']

    def apply_limits():
        os.umask(0o077)
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (limits['address_space_bytes'], limits['address_space_bytes']))
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU, (limits['cpu_soft_seconds'], limits['cpu_hard_seconds']))
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE, (limits['file_size_bytes'], limits['file_size_bytes']))
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE, (limits['open_files'], limits['open_files']))

    record = {'schema': 'pending-composition.bank-launch-receipt.v1', 'bank': bank['name'],
              'status': 'REQUESTED', 'commands_sha256': COMMANDS_SHA256,
              'command': bank['command'], 'cwd': bank['cwd'], 'environment': env,
              'limits': limits, 'wall_seconds': bank['wall_seconds'],
              'authority': 'NONE', 'readiness': 'NONE', 'native_admission': False,
              'runtime_before': runtime_before, 'subreaper': subreaper,
              'launch_attempted': False, 'driver_started': False,
              'driver_completed': False, 'driver_reaped': False,
              'start_unknown': False, 'capture_errors': [], 'process_error': None,
              'adopted_descendant_reaps': []}
    put_json(evidence / 'requested.json', record)
    child = None
    began = time.monotonic()
    try:
        with (evidence / 'stdout.bin').open('xb') as out, (evidence / 'stderr.bin').open('xb') as err:
            put_json(evidence / 'launch-intent.json',
                     {**record, 'intent': 'Popen is next; this receipt is not an attempt or start'})
            record['launch_attempted'] = True
            record['driver_started'] = None
            record['start_unknown'] = True
            child = subprocess.Popen(bank['command'], cwd=bank['cwd'], env=env,
                                     stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=out, stderr=err,
                                     start_new_session=True, preexec_fn=apply_limits)
            record.update(pid=child.pid, driver_started=True, start_unknown=False)
            put_json(evidence / 'process-start.json', record)
            try:
                record['exit'] = child.wait(timeout=bank['wall_seconds'])
                record.update(driver_completed=True, driver_reaped=True, status='BANK_EXITED')
                put_json(evidence / 'process-outcome.json', record)
                reap_adopted(child.pid, record)
                record['residual_process_group_before_containment'] = group_exists(child.pid)
                if record['residual_process_group_before_containment']:
                    record['status'] = 'UNEXPECTED_RESIDUAL_GROUP_TERMINATED'
                    contain_group(child, bank['kill_grace_seconds'], record)
                else:
                    record['residual_process_group_after_containment'] = False
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                record['status'] = 'BANK_TIMEOUT_RETAINED'
                contain_group(child, bank['kill_grace_seconds'], record)
                record['driver_completed'] = record['driver_reaped']
                put_json(evidence / 'process-outcome.json', record)
    except BaseException as error:
        record.update(status='LAUNCH_OR_CONTAINMENT_EXCEPTION_RETAINED',
                      process_error={'type': type(error).__name__, 'message': str(error),
                                     'traceback': traceback.format_exc()})
        if child is not None:
            try:
                contain_group(child, bank['kill_grace_seconds'], record)
                record['driver_completed'] = record['driver_reaped']
            except BaseException as cleanup_error:
                record['containment_error'] = {'type': type(cleanup_error).__name__,
                                               'message': str(cleanup_error)}
        # If Popen did not return a PID, no unknown group is guessed or signalled.
    finally:
        record['elapsed_seconds'] = round(time.monotonic() - began, 6)
        try:
            record['runtime_after'] = check_runtime(dependencies)
        except Exception as error:
            record['capture_errors'].append({'stage': 'runtime-after', 'type': type(error).__name__,
                                              'message': str(error)})
        for name in ('stdout', 'stderr', 'result'):
            path = Path(bank['result']) if name == 'result' else evidence / (name + '.bin')
            try:
                if not path.exists():
                    if name != 'result':
                        raise FileNotFoundError(str(path))
                    continue
                raw = path.read_bytes()
                record[name + '_file'] = {'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw), 'path': str(path)}
            except Exception as error:
                record['capture_errors'].append({'stage': name, 'type': type(error).__name__,
                                                  'message': str(error)})
        if record['capture_errors']:
            record['status'] = 'POSTCAPTURE_FAILED_RETAINED'
        record['exact_driver_start_count'] = None if record['start_unknown'] else int(record['driver_started'] is True)
        # Receipt I/O failure can leave this absent. Absence is incomplete evidence,
        # not zero execution or a successful bank; no storage-universality claim.
        put_json(evidence / 'terminal.json', record)
    print(json.dumps({key: record[key] for key in
                      ('bank', 'status', 'authority', 'driver_reaped', 'exact_driver_start_count')},
                     sort_keys=True))
    return 0 if (record['status'] == 'BANK_EXITED' and record.get('exit') == 0
                 and record['driver_completed'] and record['driver_reaped']
                 and not record.get('residual_process_group_after_containment', True)) else 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

# Checkpoint 46: independent receiving reconciliation

**The received evidence is reusable at the exact owner-dependency scope. It does not establish execution of our complete prepared source/projection.** This receiving lane performed no target import, CLI/helper call, witness, network operation, Git write or sealed-packet edit. All output is under this `received/` directory.

## Authenticated subject and read scope

The outer checkpoint is 3,975,450 bytes, SHA-256 `375152f21ed1a5aa9849c0a67caaaa3d58f6f94ce5c33dfd598576eae6af93cf`. The nested version-2 receiving packet is 1,764,564 bytes, SHA-256 `7b9669fb7f711a900eadd70bf6dea845daebeebd92e633baef22cbfd4f601804`. Its manifest is `114132dcb8ccea34d4b8fe51b62b76103c2b5643c3cb4542418ad85a677c1b6c`.

Before selective extraction, both central directories passed name, duplicate, type, encryption and bounded-size checks. All 51 outer payload files and 265 nested payload files matched their manifests in byte length, SHA-256 and retained file mode. The nested packet has 266 members including its manifest. No archive code was imported or executed.

The full independent report matches SHA-256 `cf9fcce19a76b73e06f42a60884bc58b13f51e13d9ecf9f4ec42da7c579a7946`; the actual receipt matches `8b76e0cd476dcfe7fbb8a5137c87fa5f44fce20ddab3ea6feac5c71e539659ae`. Its PASS is an ordinary independent engineering review of the exact bounded source proposal, retained portable observations and two-file receiving subsets. Foreign runtime-owner adoption, native authority and original acceptance remain absent/open.

The semantic read covered both full review reports, the actual receipt, source mappings, all 98 reconstructed projection files, all 4+14 command records and streams, every recorded snapshot, retained malformed/restored bytes, and historical/current instrument AST/bytes. Root supplied the fresh PR253 head `088809a4654ccf6f5d8d5c65423cb4733aaaa3dc`; this lane did not perform a live-ref lookup. Earlier publication-stage fields in the checkpoint remain historical records.

## Exact source equivalence

The owner candidate and ours contain the identical 65,171-byte pending file, SHA-256 `9b5faf290e08d3df77b15d5e5301a3760c4e599d16719cf8f72e1768522ea691`. The donor remains `2361a0026d108b551158eb865075912386eddb4878b71316560e46cc3597024d`. All 13 native-peer file bytes and modes match. The four executing/imported owner hashes match, as do all four frozen core dependencies. The native manifest differs only in the owner’s appended pending `additional_delta` description; its file contents, provenance and ceilings otherwise match ours.

The owner reconstructed a 98-file projection over combined core `e4fc52757d3082d12f17137600034c5ca008e82b`, current R39 native peers and three route peers. Our complete peer tree is `6ca0843f4445ecb6fff306f6479601016781ee96` (1,408 files); our separately materialized projection is `9ee5462b003556289f02b8fdf1a62b8116f77ae5` (1,419 files). Their complete populations are different.

Exactly 10 of the 13 files read by `nonprotected_code_identity` have identical bytes and modes. These three have different bytes and equal modes:

| Path | Owner bytes / SHA-256 | Our bytes / SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `skills/implementaudit/SKILL.md` | 21,248 / `265a777a7ba2bc9c1e28ea1ceda456caa39132b3387a900bbcc5ad09850b3ecf` | 20,388 / `38f8bbd7dda1a7b92abe55d50454d237af8582016a7652d5e62a8bcb65a5e7ec` |

| `skills/implementaudit/scripts/route-transaction.py` | 371,304 / `8ed51e393f4f8a3be631e48255e9aeca59dcf120a803f1601a034e5ab9e02389` | 375,105 / `ad0367c90db2a23580a2f37ecb6b87d2b774e04ce524a95bf159f038062fafa4` |

The ten equal closure paths are `skills/audit-state/SKILL.md`, `skills/implementaudit/references/continuity.md`, and the script paths for pending, result-observation, fixed source owner, native-reader shim, three bounded readers/owners, and H0. They must not be relabelled actual executions on our different 13-path closure or complete 9ee projection. This is the concrete reason a selected C31 on our projection can still add evidence.

## All actual outcomes crosschecked

The source-free crosscheck verified all 18 process records, 54 raw stdin/stdout/stderr files, 148 cumulative regular-file snapshot entries and the raw outer captures. The cumulative count repeats files across snapshots; it is not 148 distinct files. The one-byte NUL lock is included. The driver records FAIL and outer exit 1. This failure is preserved, not rerun or relabelled.

Root should reuse the supplied register-source refusal and successor-write results rather than add those already answered questions to our selected bank.

## Historical and current receiver

The historical instrument remains SHA-256 `9130dc7bc5a48adc7ad031dafb9599f4a629102501ae01726c54c4db784837c4`. The received current instrument is `dfc2ce71361230cf4fcaf52444f358ec2236da7ca203c32f4db4b38ca8c3b545`. Independent AST inspection and exact byte reversal verify one five-line insertion, adding precisely the current four-owner tuple. All six previous entries remain unchanged; the current dictionary has seven entries. The retained single receiver invocation, its four checks and its stdout/outer hashes also agree.

Both statements are therefore true and must be version-labelled: the frozen historical instrument rejects this tuple with its original unknown-profile refusal; the current received instrument recognizes it and expects `NONPROTECTED_PROJECTION_PROFILE_REQUIRED`. The donor and the sealed historical source were not changed here. Receiver recognition is not PR252 runtime adoption, native selection or semantic-owner acceptance.

## Which proposed controls still add evidence

**Counter:** P02 (version 1 / consumed 0) and N10 (version 1 / consumed 2 refusal) have already been observed through the actual new-loader CLI and retained physical state. Their precise standalone `run_row` fixtures were not executed by that bank. The other **18** selected row/cutoff meanings are absent from the received new-loader bank: P01, P03, P04, P05, N01–N09 and N11–N15. Earlier 20-row evidence on pending `8027b627…` remains valid at its own source scope; unchanged counter-loop reasoning is useful but cannot be renamed 20 actual calls on pending `9b5faf29…`.

**Custody:** these **13 selected controls** answer questions absent from the owner bank:

| Controls | Additional question |
| --- | --- |
| C03, C06 | Genuine absence, including the guarded three-read path |
| C08 | Dangling leaf through resume |
| C09–C10 | Dangling ancestor through status and resume |
| C11 | Preexisting FIFO refusal without blocking |
| C13 | Existing-state guarded four-read path |

| C18, C20 | Nested duplicate key through status and resume |
| C22, C24 | UTF-16 and UTF-8 BOM rejection |
| C26 | Scheduled nonregular-open seam, O_NONBLOCK flags, retained mutation receipt |

**C31** separately checks the exact current projection, whose read closure differs as described above. C32 is its state-conservation postcheck. The other calls are six setup calls, eight restoration checks, and three supplied semantic baselines (C05 held status, C07 dangling-leaf status, C14 duplicate-top-level status). Their role is to support the unchanged maintained exercises and the newly selected cases; they are not independent new discoveries. C26 mutates the fixture during the measured call and must never be reported as ordinary whole-store nonmutation.

Retaining the fixed **20/32** adapters is therefore supportable on concrete gaps: 18 unmatched counter meanings, 13 novel custody controls, C31 on our exact projection and the richer capture/stat contract. It is unnecessary to replay any baseline or broad historical bank. If root narrows the intended claim to the already received witness families, that can also avoid the broader execution, with untested branches stated openly. Any change to an already sealed selection requires a successor packet and cold review, not silent omission or substitution. `OBLIGATION_MAPPING.json` maps every one of the 20+32 selections.

## Evidence limits and remaining instrument obligations

Owner snapshot equality records kind, mode, device/inode, size, mtime/ctime, regular-byte hashes and symlink targets. It does **not** record uid, gid, nlink or atime. Our selected contract adds uid/gid/nlink and records atime while excluding only atime from equality. Neither set establishes ACL/xattr preservation, hostile-race resistance, external-tree invariance, power-loss durability or Windows behavior.

The owner recorder appends and persists a command record after post-capture. Its complete successful normal-path corpus does not establish the new recorder’s capture-error, start-unknown, unreaped-process or hard-stop behavior. Those instrument witnesses remain separate from product success. Similarly, the owner’s `source_unchanged` check binds four named owner hashes; it does not replace our full peer/projection before-and-after population verification. Recorded interpreter paths and isolation flags do not supply binary SHA/version or an exact full environment binding.

The original independent review verifies internally consistent retained author-produced observations. Neither it nor this read-only receiving step supplies independent process attestation, authenticated chronology, native authority, foreign runtime-owner adoption or closure of original acceptance populations.

## Curated corpus for root assembly

`reusable-evidence/` is frozen at **287 regular, single-link files / 9,503,621 bytes**. `REUSABLE_EVIDENCE_CATALOG.json` identifies every path, source, role, mode, length and SHA-256. It includes original review/receipt and relevant checks; this bank’s complete raw records, streams, snapshots, fixtures and oracles; the reconstructible source projection; donor and historical/current instrument; and the exact current closure/peer comparison inputs.

Both ZIP files, the whole checkpoint, integration37-r254 payloads and other integration areas are excluded. Bank/review absolute-prefix screening found only `[OWNER_G8_WORKSPACE]` and `/opt/codex`. No high-confidence credential pattern was found; this is a bounded screen, not a proof against every possible secret form. Raw evidence is exact and unredacted. Root’s approved privacy transformation and publication decision are separate.

The final explanatory receipt is `REPORT.json`. The principal reusable derivations are `RAW_CROSSCHECK.json`, `SOURCE_COMPARISON.json`, `INSTRUMENT_RECONCILIATION.json`, `INSTRUMENT_DELTA.patch` and `OBLIGATION_MAPPING.json`. A single initial read-only tool wrapper had a JavaScript syntax error before any nested call started; correcting its malformed argument key affected no source or target state.

def encoded(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def describe(path):
    info = path.lstat()
    assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink()
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw), 'mode': oct(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode))}


def write(path, raw):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open('xb') as stream:
        stream.write(raw)


def span(raw, name):
    matches = [n for n in ast.parse(raw).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name]
    assert len(matches) == 1
    n = matches[0]
    lines = raw.splitlines(keepends=True)
    return b''.join(lines[n.lineno - 1:n.end_lineno]), n


def apply_unified(raw, patch_lines):
    """Check only generated text hunks, in memory, without Git or filesystem writes."""
    import re
    old_lines = raw.decode().splitlines(keepends=True)
    result, cursor, index = [], 0, 0
    while index < len(patch_lines):
        header = patch_lines[index]
        if not header.startswith('@@ '):
            index += 1
            continue
        match = re.match(r'^@@ -(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? \+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? @@', header)
        assert match
        old_start = int(match.group(1)) - 1
        old_count = int(match.group(2) or 1)
        new_count = int(match.group(4) or 1)
        assert old_start >= cursor
        result.extend(old_lines[cursor:old_start])
        cursor = old_start
        old_seen = new_seen = 0
        index += 1
        while index < len(patch_lines) and not patch_lines[index].startswith('@@ '):
            line = patch_lines[index]
            assert line[:1] in {' ', '+', '-'}
            if line[0] in ' -':
                assert cursor < len(old_lines) and old_lines[cursor] == line[1:]
                cursor += 1
                old_seen += 1
            if line[0] in ' +':
                result.append(line[1:])
                new_seen += 1
            index += 1
        assert old_seen == old_count and new_seen == new_count
    result.extend(old_lines[cursor:])
    return ''.join(result).encode()


def verify_patch(path, old_root, changed):
    text = path.read_text()
    sections = text.split('diff --git ')[1:]
    assert len(sections) == len(changed)
    seen = []
    for section in sections:
        lines = section.splitlines(keepends=True)
        a, b = lines[0].strip().split()
        assert a.startswith('a/') and b == 'b/' + a[2:]
        relative = a[2:]
        seen.append(relative)
        start = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith('@@ '))
        actual = apply_unified((old_root / relative).read_bytes(), lines[start:])
        assert actual == (ROOT / 'sources/engine' / relative).read_bytes()
    assert sorted(seen) == sorted(changed)
    return {'patch': describe(path), 'from_root': str(old_root), 'paths': seen,
