# Live acquisition uses the existing producer, file custody and sticky kernel
# cancellation capability. This creates no thread, store, source selection or H0.
def validate_lifecycle_item_v1(ledger, item, completed, raw=False):
    """Pinned 0.153.4 conservative shapes; terminal transport is not success.

    Injected only by the already pinned helper. Unconfigured ledgers refuse
    lifecycle items. Raw calls stay outstanding independently of typed items.
    """
    def need(ok, reason='LIFECYCLE_ITEM_SHAPE_OR_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN'):
        if not ok:ledger._deny(reason)
    def text(value):return type(value) is str and bool(value)
    kind=item['type']
    if raw:
        common={'type','id','internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough'}
        need('id' not in item or item['id'] is None or text(item['id']))
        if kind=='reasoning':
            need({'type','summary'}<=set(item)<=common|{'summary','content','encrypted_content'} and
                 type(item['summary']) is list and (item.get('content') is None or type(item['content']) is list))
            return
        output=kind.endswith('_output')
        family=kind.removesuffix('_output')
        need(family in {'function_call','custom_tool_call'})
        identity=item.get('call_id')
        need(text(identity), 'RAW_TOOL_CALL_ID_REQUIRED')
        key=('raw',identity)
        seen=getattr(ledger,'_raw_seen',None)
        if seen is None:seen=ledger._raw_seen=set()
        if not output:
            field='arguments' if family=='function_call' else 'input'
            optional={'namespace','encrypted_function_args'} if family=='function_call' else {'namespace','status'}
            need({'type','call_id','name',field}<=set(item)<=common|{'call_id','name',field}|optional and
                 text(item['name']) and type(item[field]) is str and
                 (item.get('namespace') is None or text(item['namespace'])) and
                 item.get('status') in (None,'completed'), 'RAW_TOOL_CALL_SHAPE_UNKNOWN')
            need(identity not in seen, 'DUPLICATE_RAW_TOOL_CALL')
            seen.add(identity);ledger._items[key]=family
        else:
            optional={'namespace'} if family=='function_call' else set()
            need({'type','call_id','output'}<=set(item)<=common|{'call_id','name','output'}|optional,
                 'RAW_TOOL_OUTPUT_SHAPE_UNKNOWN')
            value=item['output']
            need(type(value) in (str,list), 'RAW_TOOL_OUTPUT_SHAPE_UNKNOWN')
            if type(value) is list:
                fields={'input_text':'text','input_image':'image_url','input_audio':'audio_url','encrypted_content':'encrypted_content'}
                for part in value:
                    need(type(part) is dict and type(part.get('type')) is str and part['type'] in fields, 'RAW_TOOL_OUTPUT_SHAPE_UNKNOWN')
                    field=fields[part['type']]
                    need({'type',field}<=set(part)<={'type',field}|({'detail'} if part['type']=='input_image' else set())
                         and type(part[field]) is str, 'RAW_TOOL_OUTPUT_SHAPE_UNKNOWN')
            need(ledger._items.get(key)==family, 'UNMATCHED_OR_DUPLICATE_RAW_TOOL_OUTPUT')
            del ledger._items[key]
        return
    if kind=='contextCompaction':
        need(set(item)=={'type','id'})
        return
    required,optional,terminal={
        'commandExecution':({'command','commandActions','cwd'},
            {'aggregatedOutput','durationMs','exitCode','pluginId','processId','scriptPath','source'}, {'completed','failed','declined'}),
        'mcpToolCall':({'arguments','server','tool'},
            {'appContext','durationMs','error','mcpAppResourceUri','pluginId','readOnlyHint','result'}, {'completed','failed'}),
        'dynamicToolCall':({'arguments','tool'},
            {'contentItems','durationMs','namespace','success'}, {'completed','failed'}),
        'collabAgentToolCall':({'agentsStates','receiverThreadIds','senderThreadId','tool'},
            {'model','prompt','reasoningEffort'}, {'completed','failed','interrupted'}),
    }[kind]
    required=required|{'type','id','status'}
    need(required<=set(item)<=required|optional and type(item['status']) is str and
         item['status'] in (terminal if completed else {'inProgress'}), 'NONTERMINAL_OR_UNKNOWN_LIFECYCLE_ITEM')
    for name in required-{'type','id','status','arguments','agentsStates','receiverThreadIds','commandActions'}:
        need(text(item[name]))
    if kind=='commandExecution':need(type(item['commandActions']) is list)
    if kind=='collabAgentToolCall':
        need(item['senderThreadId']==ledger._thread and type(item['receiverThreadIds']) is list and
             all(text(value) for value in item['receiverThreadIds']) and type(item['agentsStates']) is dict)
    if 'durationMs' in item:need(item['durationMs'] is None or type(item['durationMs']) is int and item['durationMs']>=0)
    if 'exitCode' in item:need(item['exitCode'] is None or type(item['exitCode']) is int and -(2**31)<=item['exitCode']<2**31)
    if 'success' in item:need(item['success'] is None or type(item['success']) is bool)


class OwnedStdioLiveProducerV1:
    def __init__(self, process, source_owner, claim_owner, producer_pins, *, emit,
                 selected_thread_id=None, native_module=None):
        import types
        require(type(process) is subprocess.Popen and process.poll() is None and
                process.stdin is not None and process.stdout is not None and
                not process.stdin.closed and not process.stdout.closed, 'LIVE_ORIGINAL_POPEN_REQUIRED')
        self.process, self.source_owner, self.claim = process, source_owner, claim_owner
        self.pins = {key:dict(value) for key,value in producer_pins.items()}
        loop_pin = self.pins['loop']
        require(self.pins['helper']['path'] == str(Path(__file__).absolute()), 'LIVE_ACTUAL_HELPER_SOURCE_PATH')
        self.held = []
        self.signal = None
        self._cancelled = __import__('threading').Event()
        try:
            for pin in self.pins.values():
                holder = claim_owner.PinnedFile(Path(pin['path']), max_bytes=512*1024)
                self.held.append(holder)
                source_owner._np_read_pin(pin,512*1024)
            # Read exactly the held, verified loop bytes; normal import path
            # search and a later hash of already executing code are not used.
            loop_raw = source_owner._np_read_pin(loop_pin,128*1024)
            module = types.ModuleType('_owned_stdio_live_loop_'+digest(loop_raw))
            module.__file__ = loop_pin['path']
            exec(compile(loop_raw,loop_pin['path'],'exec',dont_inherit=True),module.__dict__)
            self.loop = module.OwnedStdioLoop(process,source_owner,selected_thread_id=selected_thread_id,
                emit=emit,mode='strict',native_module=native_module)
            self.loop._live_producer = self
            self.loop.ledger._lifecycle_validator = validate_lifecycle_item_v1
            self.process_identity = claim_owner.native_process_identity_v1(process.pid)
            self.producer_identity = claim_owner.native_process_identity_v1(os.getpid())
            self._stdio = (process.stdin,process.stdout,process.stdin.fileno(),process.stdout.fileno())
            self._sealed = None
        except BaseException:
            for holder in reversed(self.held):holder.close()
            raise

    def check(self):
        require(not self._cancelled.is_set(), 'LIVE_CAPTURE_CANCELLED')
        require(self.process.poll() is None and self.process.stdin is self._stdio[0] and
                self.process.stdout is self._stdio[1] and not self.process.stdin.closed and not self.process.stdout.closed and
                (self.process.stdin.fileno(),self.process.stdout.fileno()) == self._stdio[2:] and
                self.claim.native_process_identity_v1(self.process.pid) == self.process_identity and
                self.claim.native_process_identity_v1(os.getpid()) == self.producer_identity,
                'LIVE_OWNED_PROCESS_OR_PIPE_CHANGED')
        for holder in self.held:holder.verify()
        if self.signal is not None:self.signal.check()

    def seal(self, runtime):
        """Freeze an unadmitted initial acquisition from this actual connection."""
        import secrets
        require(self._sealed is None and self.signal is None, 'LIVE_ACQUISITION_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED')
        require(not self._cancelled.is_set(), 'LIVE_CAPTURE_CANCELLED_BEFORE_SIGNAL_INSTALL')
        nonce = secrets.token_hex(16)
        try:
            # Failure/EOF before event installation is sticky. Installation and
            # the final publication fence share the reader's state lock.
            with self.loop._state_lock:
                self.loop.live_acquisition_facts_v1()
                self.signal = self.claim.NativeCancellationSignalV1(nonce)
                if self._cancelled.is_set():self.signal.signal()
                require(not self._cancelled.is_set(), 'LIVE_CAPTURE_CANCELLED_DURING_SIGNAL_INSTALL')
                self.signal.check()
                epoch = self.loop._raw_epoch
            return self._seal(runtime, nonce, epoch)
        except BaseException:
            self.cancel_now()
            if self.signal is not None:self.signal.close()
            raise

    def _seal(self, runtime, nonce, epoch):
        selected, custody_owner, protocol, helpers, _ = runtime
        require(self._sealed is None, 'LIVE_ACQUISITION_ALREADY_SEALED')
        self.check()
        require(self.process.args == [selected['native_executable']['path'],'app-server','--listen','stdio://'] and
                self.process_identity['image'] == selected['native_executable']['path'] and
                self.pins == {'runner':selected['capture_producer_pin'],
                    **{key:selected['producer_dependencies'][name] for key,name in
                       (('loop','owned_stdio_loop.py'),('claim','claim-run-rotation.py'),('helper','bounded_source_owner.py'),('source_owner','compaction-source-owner-codex-app.py'))}},
                'LIVE_PRODUCER_OR_LAUNCH_DIFFERS')
        # The loop returns only facts retained at actual send/reply, under its
        # ingress barrier. No caller supplies a thread/read response or flag.
        facts = self.loop.live_acquisition_facts_v1()
        require(facts['thread_id'] == selected['root_thread_id'] and facts['source_path'] == selected['root_source'] and
                facts['thread_start']['experimentalRawEvents'] is True and
                facts['thread_start']['cwd'] == selected['cwd'], 'LIVE_NATIVE_ACQUISITION_SCOPE')
        header = helpers.header({'path':selected['root_source']})
        require(header['metadata'].get('id') == header['metadata'].get('session_id') == selected['root_thread_id'] and
            header['metadata'].get('cli_version') == selected['cli_version'] and
            Path(header['metadata'].get('cwd','')) == Path(selected['cwd']), 'LIVE_ORIGINAL_HEADER_DIFFERS')
        physical = {key:header['physical'][key] for key in ('device','inode')}
        context = {'parent':{'path':selected['root_source'],'physical':physical,
            'metadata':{'bytes':header['header_prefix']['bytes']}}}
        size = Path(selected['root_source']).stat().st_size
        prefix = self.source_owner.sealed_prefix(helpers._observation_owner,context,'parent',size)
        require(self.loop.live_acquisition_facts_v1() == facts, 'LIVE_CAPTURE_INGRESS_ADVANCED_DURING_SEAL')
        source = {'path':selected['root_source'],'bytes':size,'sha256':prefix['prefix_sha256'],'physical':physical,
            'metadata':{'id':selected['root_thread_id'],'session_id':selected['root_thread_id'],'cli_version':selected['cli_version']}}
        record = {'schema':'implementaudit.owned-stdio-live-acquisition.v1','status':'LIVE_SOURCE_CAPTURED_UNADMITTED',
            'thread_id':selected['root_thread_id'],'native_version':selected['native_version'],
            'native_executable_sha256':selected['native_executable']['sha256'],'transport':'dedicated-owner-started-stdio',
            'profile_admission':'UNADMITTED','native_pending_consumption':False,
            'capture_script_sha256':self.pins['runner']['sha256'],'producer_dependencies':selected['producer_dependencies'],
            'codex_home':selected['codex_home'],'cwd':selected['cwd'],'source':source,'connection':facts,
            'producer_process':self.producer_identity,'host_process':self.process_identity,
            'cancellation':self.signal.descriptor,'connection_id':nonce,'authority_ceiling':'NONE'}
        self.check()
        with self.loop._state_lock:
            require(not self._cancelled.is_set() and self.loop._raw_epoch == epoch and
                    self.loop.live_acquisition_facts_v1() == facts, 'LIVE_CAPTURE_INVALIDATED_DURING_SEAL')
            self.signal.check()
            self._sealed = record
        return json.loads(json.dumps(record))

    def cancel_now(self):
        self._cancelled.set()
        if self.signal is not None and self.signal.handle:self.signal.signal()

    def finish(self):
        self.cancel_now()
        if self.signal is not None:self.signal.close()
        for holder in reversed(self.held):holder.close()


def validate_live_capture_v1(selected, capture, read_pin):
    fields = {'schema','status','thread_id','native_version','native_executable_sha256','transport',
        'profile_admission','native_pending_consumption','capture_script_sha256','producer_dependencies',
        'codex_home','cwd','source','connection','producer_process','host_process','cancellation','connection_id','authority_ceiling'}
    require(type(capture) is dict and set(capture) == fields and
        capture['schema'] == 'implementaudit.owned-stdio-live-acquisition.v1' and
        capture['status'] == 'LIVE_SOURCE_CAPTURED_UNADMITTED' and capture['profile_admission'] == 'UNADMITTED' and
        capture['native_pending_consumption'] is False and capture['authority_ceiling'] == 'NONE' and
        capture['transport'] == 'dedicated-owner-started-stdio' and
        capture['thread_id'] == selected['root_thread_id'] and capture['native_version'] == selected['native_version'] and
        capture['native_executable_sha256'] == selected['native_executable']['sha256'] and
        capture['capture_script_sha256'] == selected['capture_producer_pin']['sha256'] and
        capture['producer_dependencies'] == selected['producer_dependencies'] and
        capture['codex_home'] == selected['codex_home'] and capture['cwd'] == selected['cwd'], 'LIVE_CAPTURE_FIXED_BINDING')
    deps = selected['producer_dependencies']
    require(type(deps) is dict and set(deps) == {'owned_stdio_loop.py','claim-run-rotation.py','bounded_source_owner.py','compaction-source-owner-codex-app.py'}, 'LIVE_PRODUCER_CLOSURE_REQUIRED')
    read_pin(selected['capture_producer_pin'],128*1024)
    read_pin(deps['owned_stdio_loop.py'],128*1024)
    read_pin(deps['claim-run-rotation.py'],512*1024)
    read_pin(deps['bounded_source_owner.py'],128*1024)
    read_pin(deps['compaction-source-owner-codex-app.py'],128*1024)
    facts = capture['connection']
    require(type(facts) is dict and set(facts) == {'thread_id','source_path','thread_start','effective_config',
        'thread_start_response_sha256','thread_read_response_sha256','read_frame_ordinal','wire_prefix_sha256','wire_prefix_bytes'} and
        facts['thread_id'] == selected['root_thread_id'] and facts['source_path'] == selected['root_source'] and
        type(facts['thread_start']) is dict and facts['thread_start'].get('experimentalRawEvents') is True and
        facts['thread_start'].get('cwd') == selected['cwd'] and type(facts['effective_config']) is dict and
        all(type(facts[k]) is str and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',facts[k]) for k in
            ('thread_start_response_sha256','thread_read_response_sha256','wire_prefix_sha256')) and
        all(type(facts[k]) is int and facts[k] > 0 for k in ('read_frame_ordinal','wire_prefix_bytes')), 'LIVE_CAPTURE_CONNECTION_FACTS')
    source = capture['source']
    require(type(source) is dict and set(source) == {'path','bytes','sha256','physical','metadata'} and
        source['path'] == selected['root_source'] and source['metadata'] == {'id':selected['root_thread_id'],
            'session_id':selected['root_thread_id'],'cli_version':selected['cli_version']} and
        type(source['bytes']) is int and source['bytes'] > 0 and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',source['sha256']), 'LIVE_CAPTURE_SOURCE_FACTS')
    return capture


def held_live_capture_v1(selected, capture, claim_owner):
    """Active reads require an actual kernel Event plus current PID/birth/image."""
    from contextlib import contextmanager, ExitStack
    @contextmanager
    def held():
        with ExitStack() as stack:
            waiter = claim_owner.NativeCancellationWaitV1(capture['cancellation'],capture['producer_process'],capture['connection_id'])
            stack.callback(waiter.close)
            pins = [selected['capture_producer_pin'],*selected['producer_dependencies'].values()]
            holders=[]
            for pin in pins:
                holder=claim_owner.PinnedFile(Path(pin['path']),max_bytes=512*1024)
                holders.append(holder);stack.callback(holder.close)
            def verify():
                waiter.check()
                require(claim_owner.native_process_identity_v1(capture['host_process']['pid']) == capture['host_process'] and
                    capture['host_process']['image'] == selected['native_executable']['path'], 'LIVE_HOST_DEAD_OR_REPLACED')
                for holder in holders:holder.verify()
                waiter.check()
            verify(); yield; verify()
    return held()


def read_preopen_route_v1(runtime, executing_owner):
    """Read the selected canonical owner; exceptions are never absence proof."""
    selected=runtime[0];owner=selected['episode_owner']
    route=executing_owner._np_module(owner['module_pin'],'route-transaction.py',runtime[1])
    with route.current_route_observation_v1(Path(owner['repository']),owner['controller']) as observed:
        raw=observed.scope_bytes()
        value=parse(raw)
        require(value.get('schema')=='implementaudit.current-route-scope.v1' and
                value.get('authority_ceiling')=='READ_ONLY_CURRENT_ROUTE_FACT' and
                value.get('route',{}).get('route_state')=='UNSATISFIED' and
                value['route'].get('decision')=='REQUIRED' and
                value.get('owner',{}).get('controller_id')==owner['controller'] and
                value.get('host',{}).get('host_session_id')==selected['root_thread_id'],
                'INITIAL_TRANSFER_REQUIRES_CURRENT_PREOPEN_ROUTE')
    return raw


def transfer_live_interval_v1(runtime, producer, executing_owner, read_release):
    """Transfer actual initialization custody; no old ledger grants acceptance."""
    loop = producer.loop
    require(type(producer.process) is subprocess.Popen and loop.process is producer.process,
            'ORIGINAL_LIVE_PROCESS_REQUIRED_FOR_TRANSFER')
    producer.check()
    require(producer._sealed == executing_owner._as_capture_v1(runtime[0],runtime[1]),
            'LIVE_INITIAL_ACQUISITION_DIFFERS_FROM_SELECTION')
    # Git/pending reads occur outside the ingress lock. The raw epoch barrier
    # rejects any overlap before the new ledger can be made visible.
    with loop._arm_lock:
        with loop._state_lock:
            epoch = loop._raw_epoch
            loop._assert_interval_transferable()
            if read_release is None:
                require(loop._transfer_stage=='CAPTURE' and not loop._retired_intervals and not loop.ledger._lifecycle,
                        'INITIAL_TRANSFER_ALREADY_USED_OR_WRONG_STAGE')
            else:
                require(loop._transfer_stage=='C5_LIFECYCLE', 'C5_TRANSFER_WRONG_STAGE')
        preopen=None if read_release is not None else read_preopen_route_v1(runtime,executing_owner)
        release = None if read_release is None else read_release()
        require(read_release is None or release is not None, 'EXISTING_C5_TERMINAL_RELEASE_REQUIRED')
        if release is not None:
            require(release.get('status') == 'AVAILABLE' and
                release['lifecycle']['source_terminal_release']['status'] == 'SOURCE_OWNER_VALIDATED' and
                release['lifecycle']['join']['status'] == 'JOINED_EVIDENCE_ONLY' and
                release['episode']['parent_identity']['thread_id'] == runtime[0]['root_thread_id'],
                'EXISTING_C5_TERMINAL_RELEASE_REQUIRED')
            # Retain the entire original covered/uncovered census. No row is
            # consumed or relabeled by this transport interval transition.
            retained = {'export_digest':release['export_digest'],'pending':release['pending'],
                        'terminal_release':release['lifecycle']['source_terminal_release']}
            expected_children = {release['episode']['actual_child_identity']['thread_id']}
        else:
            retained = {'kind':'INITIAL_UNADMITTED_CONNECTION_TRANSFER','authority_ceiling':'NONE'}
            expected_children = set()
        producer.check()
        if preopen is not None:
            require(read_preopen_route_v1(runtime,executing_owner)==preopen, 'INITIAL_TRANSFER_ROUTE_CHANGED')
        with loop._state_lock:
            loop._assert_interval_transferable()
            require(loop._raw_epoch == epoch and loop.ledger._children == expected_children,
                    'LIVE_TRANSFER_INGRESS_OR_UNRECONCILED_CHILD')
            old = loop.ledger
            new = executing_owner.OwnedStdioQuiescenceV1(loop.messages,
                selected_thread_id=runtime[0]['root_thread_id'],native_process=producer.process)
            # These are the actual retained exchange objects from the sole
            # sender/reader, not fabricated initialize records or booleans.
            init = loop._actual_initialize
            require(init['sent']['method'] == 'initialize' and type(init['sent']['id']) is int and
                type(init['reply'].get('id')) is int and init['sent']['id'] == init['reply']['id'] and
                loop._actual_initialized == {'method':'initialized'}, 'ORIGINAL_INITIALIZE_EXCHANGE_REQUIRED')
            new.before_send(init['sent']); new.after_record(init['reply']); new.before_send(loop._actual_initialized)
            new._lifecycle_validator=validate_lifecycle_item_v1
            loop._retired_intervals.append((old,retained))
            loop.source_owner=executing_owner;producer.source_owner=executing_owner;loop.ledger=new
            loop.native_state=None;loop._usage_binding=None
            loop._actual_read=None
            loop._actual_resume=None
            loop._transfer_stage='SELECTED_NEEDS_RESUME' if release is None else 'FRESH_NEEDS_RESUME'
            event = {'event':'OWNED_INTERVAL_TRANSFER','retired_intervals':len(loop._retired_intervals),
                     'after_c5':release is not None,'retained_export_digest':None if release is None else release['export_digest'],
                     'authority_ceiling':'NONE','next_required_native_request':'thread/resume'}
        loop.emit(event)  # No fsync/journal work under the raw-ingress lock.
        return retained


def load_live_claim_v1(pin, read_pin):
    # Initial unadmitted producer template and final materialized owner are
    # distinct declared roles. The already frozen canonical claim companion
    # can be held by both; no physical owner equivalence is inferred.
    import types
    require(Path(pin['path']).name == 'claim-run-rotation.py', 'LIVE_CLAIM_COMPANION_NAME')
    raw=read_pin(pin,512*1024)
    module=types.ModuleType('_live_claim_'+digest(raw));module.__file__=pin['path']
    exec(compile(raw,pin['path'],'exec',dont_inherit=True),module.__dict__)
    require(all(callable(getattr(module,name,None)) for name in
        ('PinnedFile','NativeCancellationSignalV1','NativeCancellationWaitV1','native_process_identity_v1')),
        'LIVE_CLAIM_CUSTODY_INTERFACE_REQUIRED')
    return module


def initial_transfer_and_open_v1(runtime, producer, owner, opening, *, execute=False, deadline=None):
    import sys, time
    if execute is not True:
        return {'status':'PREPARED_NO_EFFECTS','sequence':[
            'current UNSATISFIED owner read','one initial selected-owner transfer',
            'actual warm thread/resume on retained pipes','same-source thread/read',
            'fresh exact pre-OPEN owner read','existing route-transaction.py open CAS',
            'existing canonical OPEN readback'], 'authority_ceiling':'NONE'}
    def need(ok,code):
        if not ok:raise ValueError(code)
    selected=runtime[0];loop=producer.loop
    required={'request','packet','logical_task','expected_record','binding_generation'}
    need(type(opening) is dict and set(opening)==required and
         all(type(value) is str and value for value in opening.values()), 'EXACT_PREPARED_OPEN_ARGUMENTS_REQUIRED')
    need(type(deadline) in (int,float) and 0<deadline-time.monotonic()<=30,
         'BOUNDED_INITIAL_DRIVER_DEADLINE_REQUIRED')
    need(owner.OWNED_STDIO_SELECTION_PIN is not None and selected==owner._np_selection() and
         loop._live_producer is producer and loop._transfer_stage=='CAPTURE', 'INITIAL_DRIVER_SCOPE_OR_REPLAY')
    producer.check()
    capture=producer._sealed
    need(type(capture) is dict and capture.get('schema')=='implementaudit.owned-stdio-live-acquisition.v1' and
         capture['thread_id']==selected['root_thread_id'] and capture['source']['path']==selected['root_source'],
         'INITIAL_DRIVER_LIVE_SOURCE_IDENTITY_REQUIRED')
    for key in ('request','packet'):
        path=Path(opening[key])
        need(path.is_absolute() and path.resolve(strict=True)==path, 'PREPARED_OPEN_PATH_ALIAS')
    try:
        with owner._as_provider_guard_v1(runtime):
            owner.transfer_owned_stdio_interval_v1(runtime,producer,after_c5=False)
            resumed=loop.call('thread/resume',{'threadId':selected['root_thread_id'],
                'excludeTurns':True,'approvalPolicy':'never','sandbox':'read-only'},deadline)
            need(resumed.get('thread',{}).get('id')==selected['root_thread_id'] and
                 resumed['thread'].get('path')==selected['root_source'], 'WARM_RESUME_ACTUAL_SOURCE_CHANGED')
            read=loop.call('thread/read',{'threadId':selected['root_thread_id'],'includeTurns':False},deadline)
            need(read.get('thread',{}).get('id')==selected['root_thread_id'] and
                 read['thread'].get('path')==selected['root_source'], 'WARM_READ_ACTUAL_SOURCE_CHANGED')
            scope=json.loads(runtime[3].read_preopen_route_v1(runtime,owner))
            need(scope['route']['record_oid']==opening['expected_record'] and
                 scope['host']['host_binding_generation']==opening['binding_generation'], 'PREOPEN_EXPECTED_OWNER_CHANGED')
            episode_owner=selected['episode_owner'];pin=episode_owner['module_pin']
            owner._np_read_pin(pin,512*1024,runtime[1])
            producer.check()
            with loop._state_lock:
                loop._assert_interval_transferable()
                need(loop._transfer_stage=='SELECTED_RESUMED' and loop._actual_resume is not None,
                     'OPEN_REQUIRES_ACTUAL_SELECTED_WARM_RESUME')
                loop._transfer_stage='OPEN_IN_FLIGHT'
            argv=[sys.executable,'-I','-S','-B',pin['path'],'open',
                '--controller',episode_owner['controller'],'--store',selected['pending_owner']['store'],
                '--host-id','codex','--host-session-id',selected['root_thread_id'],
                '--binding-generation',opening['binding_generation'],'--request',opening['request'],
                '--expected-record',opening['expected_record'],'--packet',opening['packet'],
                '--logical-task',opening['logical_task']]
            remaining=deadline-time.monotonic()
            need(remaining>0,'INITIAL_DRIVER_DEADLINE_BEFORE_OPEN')
            with producer.claim.PinnedFile(Path(pin['path']),max_bytes=512*1024) as route_file:
                raw=route_file.read()
                need(len(raw)==pin['bytes'] and digest(raw)==pin['sha256'], 'OPEN_OWNER_SOURCE_CHANGED')
                result=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=episode_owner['repository'],capture_output=True,
                    check=False,timeout=remaining)
                route_file.verify()
            need(result.returncode==0,'EXISTING_OPEN_REFUSED_OR_UNKNOWN_READBACK_REQUIRED')
            opened=json.loads(result.stdout)
            need(opened.get('status')=='CHILD_OPEN','EXISTING_OPEN_RESULT_UNKNOWN')
            owner._np_read_pin(pin,512*1024,runtime[1]);producer.check()
            episode=owner._np_episode(runtime)
            need(episode['logical_task']==opening['logical_task'] and
                 episode['host_and_scope']['host_session_id']==selected['root_thread_id'] and
                 episode['open_record_oid']==opened.get('record_oid') and
                 episode['open_record_identity']==opened.get('record_identity'), 'OPEN_READBACK_IDENTITY_CHANGED')
            with loop._state_lock:
                loop._assert_interval_transferable()
                need(loop._transfer_stage=='OPEN_IN_FLIGHT','OPEN_STAGE_CHANGED')
                loop._transfer_stage='OPEN_VERIFIED'
            return {'status':'EXISTING_OPEN_VERIFIED_NATIVE_CHILD_NOT_STARTED',
                    'open':opened,'episode':episode,'authority_ceiling':'NONE'}
    except BaseException as exc:
        # CAS can already have occurred. The stopped, sticky producer cannot be
        # replayed; ROOT must reconcile the existing owner before any successor.
        loop._record_failure(exc)
        raise


def owned_stdio_public_turn_v2(obs, context, role, pin):
    """Read the complete finite 0.153.4 public interval, segmented by real turns.

    The C5 protocol has seven parent turns through its final release. Each turn
    retains the original 64-frame limit; the fresh child still has exactly one
    turn. The original two-MiB whole interval and per-frame byte bounds remain.
    Every byte/frame from the bound original anchor to selected response is read.
    No profile, turn ID, source locator or native-public confirmation is minted.
    """
    require(context.get('profile_id') == 'codex-app-server-0.153.4-owned-stdio-candidate-v1'
            and role in ('parent', 'child') and obs.MAX_RECORDS == 64, 'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_PROFILE_SCOPE')
    anchor = context['parent_turn_start'] if role == 'parent' else context['child_activation']
    first_locator, last_locator = anchor['locator'], pin['locator']
    start, end = first_locator['offset'], last_locator['offset'] + last_locator['bytes']
    require(type(start) is int and type(end) is int and 0 <= start < end and end-start <= obs.MAX_TOTAL,
            'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_TURN_BOUND')
    path, before = obs.physical(context[role]['path'])
    require(obs.identity(before) == context[role]['physical'] and end <= before.st_size,
            'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_PHYSICAL_CHANGED')
    maximum_turns = 7 if role == 'parent' else 1
    active, seen, frames, context_seen, previous_ordinal = None, set(), 0, False, None
    uuid = r'[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}'
    selected_seen = False
    position = start
    prefix_hash = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        require(obs.identity(os.fstat(stream.fileno())) == context[role]['physical'],
                'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_PHYSICAL_CHANGED')
        stream.seek(start)
        while position < end:
            raw = stream.readline(min(obs.MAX_RECORD+1, end-position))
            require(raw and raw.endswith(b'\n') and raw.count(b'\n') == 1
                    and b'\r' not in raw and b'\0' not in raw and len(raw) <= obs.MAX_RECORD,
                    'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_TURN_FRAME')
            row = obs.json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=obs.unique)
            require(type(row) is dict and set(row) == {'timestamp', 'ordinal', 'type', 'payload'}
                    and type(row['payload']) is dict and type(row['type']) is str
                    and type(row['timestamp']) is str and type(row['ordinal']) is int and row['ordinal'] >= 0,
                    'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_FRAME_SHAPE')
            require(previous_ordinal is None or row['ordinal'] == previous_ordinal+1,
                    'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_ORDINAL_GAP_OR_REPLAY')
            previous_ordinal = row['ordinal']
            p, kind = row['payload'], row['type']
            event = p.get('type') if kind == 'event_msg' else None
            if position == start:
                require(len(raw) == first_locator['bytes'] and digest(raw) == first_locator['sha256']
                        and row['ordinal'] == first_locator['embedded_ordinal'] and event == 'task_started',
                        'OWNED_STDIO_ORIGINAL_TURN_ANCHOR_CHANGED')
            if event == 'task_started':
                identity = p.get('turn_id')
                require(active is None, 'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_OVERLAPPING_TURNS')
                require(type(identity) is str and re.fullmatch(uuid, identity) and identity not in seen,
                        'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_DUPLICATE_OR_UNKNOWN_TURN')
                seen.add(identity)
                require(len(seen) <= maximum_turns, 'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_TURN_POPULATION_BOUND')
                active, frames, context_seen = identity, 0, False
            else:
                require(active is not None, 'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_FRAME_OUTSIDE_ACTUAL_TURN')
            frames += 1
            require(frames <= obs.MAX_RECORDS, 'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_TURN_FRAME')
            if 'turn_id' in p:
                require(p['turn_id'] == active, 'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_FOREIGN_TURN_FRAME')
            if kind == 'turn_context':
                require(not context_seen and p.get('turn_id') == active,
                        'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_CONTEXT_ABSENT_DUPLICATE_OR_FOREIGN')
                require(type(p.get('root_turn_id')) is str and re.fullmatch(uuid, p['root_turn_id'])
                        and (role != 'parent' or p['root_turn_id'] == active),
                        'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_ROOT_TURN_CHANGED')
                context_seen = True
            elif event == 'task_complete':
                require(context_seen and p.get('turn_id') == active, 'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_TERMINAL_WITHOUT_CONTEXT')
                active = None
            elif kind == 'event_msg':
                require(event in ('task_started', 'item_completed', 'token_count'),
                        'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_UNKNOWN_OR_INVALIDATING_EVENT')
                require(event != 'item_completed' or p.get('turn_id') == active,
                        'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_FOREIGN_TURN_FRAME')
            elif kind == 'token_usage_record':
                require(p.get('turn_id') == active, 'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_FOREIGN_TURN_FRAME')
            elif kind == 'response_item':
                require(p.get('type') in ('message', 'reasoning', 'function_call', 'function_call_output',
                        'custom_tool_call', 'custom_tool_call_output', 'agent_message'),
                        'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_UNKNOWN_RESPONSE_FRAME')
            else:
                require(kind in ('world_state', 'inter_agent_communication_metadata'),
                        'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_UNKNOWN_FRAME')
            if position == last_locator['offset']:
                require(len(raw) == last_locator['bytes'] and digest(raw) == last_locator['sha256']
                        and row['ordinal'] == last_locator['embedded_ordinal'] and position+len(raw) == end
                        and active is not None and context_seen and kind == 'response_item'
                        and p.get('type') == 'message' and p.get('role') == 'assistant',
                        'OWNED_STDIO_SELECTED_PUBLIC_RESPONSE_CHANGED')
                selected_seen = True
            prefix_hash.update(raw)
            position += len(raw)
        after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        # Recheck the entire traversed original prefix, not just the chosen row.
        stream.seek(start)
        checked = hashlib.sha256()
        remaining = end-start
        while remaining:
            raw = stream.read(min(65536, remaining))
            require(raw, 'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_PREFIX_TRUNCATED')
            checked.update(raw)
            remaining -= len(raw)
    _, current = obs.physical(path)
    require(selected_seen and position == end and checked.digest() == prefix_hash.digest()
            and obs.identity(before) == obs.identity(after) == obs.identity(current)
            and (before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) == (after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns)
                == (current.st_size, current.st_mtime_ns), 'OWNED_STDIO_PUBLIC_PREFIX_CHANGED')
    return active

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""PORTABLE process-crash and path-custody qualification of the pending owner.

Uses real H0/pending CLIs and constructed attribution only. The worker seams
import the actual owner: status denies observation/writes and crash exits
immediately around its real
pending.json os.replace. No native selector, registration, acceptance, JOIN,
or consumed scope is fabricated. This is not a power-loss/fsync guarantee.

Run from an integrated tests/ directory, or pass --repo-root for a proposal.
--evidence-dir must name a new directory; it retains every process result and
pending preimage, including unexpected failures. Without it a temp directory
is retained and its path is printed in the final JSON report.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ast
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import time
import traceback

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PEER = Path("source-peers/native-runtime/skills/implementaudit/scripts")
OWNER = "fixture-owner"
SESSION = "portable-pending-session"
CEILING = {
    "authority": "NONE", "canonical_currentness": False,
    "recovery_authority": False, "epoch_authority": False,
    "effect_authority": False, "independent_children": "UNCHANGED",
    "actual_child_result_consumer": "UNQUALIFIED",
    "same_failed_scope_retry": "CONDITIONAL_UNQUALIFIED",
}
LIMITATIONS = [
    "Constructed H0 attribution only; host_activation_proven=false.",
    "Unresolved explicit resume deliveries are not physical occurrence proof.",
    "Private native selection remains absent; no reservation or accepted native JOIN is proved.",
    "Only process interruption/reload is tested, not power loss or directory-fsync durability.",
]


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(message)


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def ceiling(value, *, decision=False):
    for key, expected in CEILING.items():
        require(value.get(key) == expected and type(value.get(key)) is type(expected), key)
    if decision:
        require(value["native_lifecycle"] == "NOT_CLAIMED", "native lifecycle promoted")
        require(value["native_producer_runtime_equivalence"] == "UNVERIFIED", "native equivalence promoted")


def worker(mode, source_text, store_text, session, owner, action):
    """Fault/guard scheduling only; all pending semantics remain in source."""
    source, store = Path(source_text), Path(store_text)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_portable_actual_pending", source)
    pending = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(pending)
    target = pending.state_path(store, session)
    require(target.is_relative_to(store), "fault target escaped fixture store")
    sys.argv = [str(source), "--store", str(store), "--session", session,
                "--owner-id", owner, action]
    if mode in ("before-replace", "after-replace"):
        actual_replace = pending.CORE.os.replace

        def scheduled_replace(src, dst, *args, **kwargs):
            if Path(dst) != target:
                return actual_replace(src, dst, *args, **kwargs)
            # CORE.atomic_json has flushed/fsynced its actual temp file here.
            if mode == "after-replace":
                actual_replace(src, dst, *args, **kwargs)
            sys.stderr.write("FAULT_REACHED " + mode + " " + str(target) + "\n")
            sys.stderr.flush()
            os._exit(91 if mode == "before-replace" else 92)

        pending.CORE.os.replace = scheduled_replace
        return pending.main()
    if mode == "pending-open-nonregular":
        require(action == "status", "open-boundary worker requires status")
        actual_lstat, actual_open = Path.lstat, os.open
        retained = target.with_name("retained-stored-json-open.pending.json")
        reached, opened_flags = [], []

        def scheduled_lstat(path, *args, **kwargs):
            info = actual_lstat(path, *args, **kwargs)
            if path == target and not reached:
                target.rename(retained)
                if hasattr(os, "mkfifo"):
                    os.mkfifo(target)
                else:
                    target.mkdir()
                reached.append(True)
            return info

        def observed_open(path, flags, *args, **kwargs):
            if Path(path) == target:
                opened_flags.append(flags)
            return actual_open(path, flags, *args, **kwargs)

        Path.lstat, os.open = scheduled_lstat, observed_open
        result = pending.main()
        require(reached and result == 2, "scheduled unsafe open did not refuse")
        require(all(flags & getattr(os, "O_NONBLOCK", 0) for flags in opened_flags)
                if hasattr(os, "O_NONBLOCK") else True, "unsafe open could block")
        sys.stderr.write(json.dumps({"pending_open_boundary": "REFUSED",
                                     "scheduled_kind": "fifo" if hasattr(os, "mkfifo") else "directory",
                                     "opened_flags": opened_flags}, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
        return result
    require(mode == "status-guard" and action == "status", "unknown worker mode")

    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
        raise AssertionError("status attempted observation, locking, or mutation")

    for name in ("refresh", "scan_source", "_scan_source_unheld", "record_signal",
                 "save", "nonprotected_code_identity"):
        setattr(pending, name, forbidden)
    pending.CORE.writer_lock = forbidden
    pending.CORE.atomic_json = forbidden
    allowed = {
        pending.CORE.owner_path(store),
        pending.CORE.state_path(store, "codex", session),
        pending.CORE.session_index_path(store, session),
    }
    if target.exists():
        allowed.add(target)
    opened = []

    def audit(event, args):
        if event == "open":
            path, mode_text, flags = args
            require(not flags & (os.O_WRONLY | os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC | os.O_APPEND),
                    "status attempted a writable open")
            require(isinstance(path, (str, bytes, os.PathLike)) and Path(os.fsdecode(path)) in allowed,
                    "status read outside exact owner/binding/index/pending files: " + str(path))
            opened.append(str(path))
        elif event in ("os.listdir", "os.scandir", "os.rename", "os.remove", "os.rmdir",
                       "os.mkdir", "subprocess.Popen", "os.system", "socket.connect"):
            raise AssertionError("status attempted forbidden event: " + event)

    sys.addaudithook(audit)
    result = pending.main()
    require(result == 0, "guarded status refused")
    require(len(opened) == len(allowed) and set(opened) == {str(p) for p in allowed},
            "status did not use one bounded read per expected custody file")
    sys.stderr.write(json.dumps({"status_guard": "PASS", "read_count": len(opened),
                                 "observations": 0, "writes": 0}, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return result


class Harness:
    def __init__(self, repo, evidence):
        self.repo, self.evidence = repo, evidence
        self.scripts = repo / PEER
        self.fixture = evidence / "constructed"
        self.store = self.fixture / "store"
        self.pending = self.store / "compaction-audits-v1" / sha(SESSION.encode()) / "pending.json"
        self.preimages = evidence / "preimages"
        self.preimages.mkdir()
        self.records, self.controls = [], []

    def mark(self, name):
        self.controls.append(name)
        print("PASS " + name, flush=True)

    def snapshot(self):
        """Include names, file bytes, metadata and directory metadata; omit atime."""
        result = {}
        for path in [self.store, *sorted(self.store.rglob("*"))]:
            info = path.lstat()
            result[str(path.relative_to(self.store))] = {
                "mode": info.st_mode, "inode": info.st_ino,
                "mtime_ns": info.st_mtime_ns, "ctime_ns": info.st_ctime_ns,
                "bytes": info.st_size if stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) else None,
                "sha256": sha(path.read_bytes()) if stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) else None,
            }
        return result

    def preserve(self, number, stage):
        # Unsafe-path controls must never follow a link or read a FIFO while
        # preserving the actual process boundary.
        if self.pending.is_symlink() or not self.pending.is_file():
            return None
        raw = self.pending.read_bytes()
        path = self.preimages / (f"{number:03d}-{stage}.pending.json")
        path.write_bytes(raw)
        return {"path": str(path.relative_to(self.evidence)), "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": sha(raw)}

    def call(self, action, data=None, *, script="compaction-audit-pending.py", args=None,
             mode=None, owner=OWNER, raw=None, expected_exit=0):
        number = len(self.records) + 1
        if args is None:
            args = ["--store", str(self.store), "--session", SESSION,
                    "--owner-id", owner, action]
        command = [sys.executable, "-B", str(self.scripts / script), *args]
        if mode:
            command = [sys.executable, "-B", str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "--worker", mode,
                       str(self.scripts / script), str(self.store), SESSION, owner, action]
        wire = raw if raw is not None else "" if data is None else json.dumps(data)
        record = {"number": number, "command": command, "input": wire,
                  "pending_before": self.preserve(number, "before")}
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            process = subprocess.run(command, input=wire, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=15)
            record.update(exit=process.returncode, stdout=process.stdout, stderr=process.stderr)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
            record.update(timeout_seconds=15, stdout=str(error.stdout), stderr=str(error.stderr))
            raise
        finally:
            record["elapsed_seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 6)
            record["pending_after"] = self.preserve(number, "after")
            self.records.append(record)
            with (self.evidence / "process-records.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
                stream.write(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
        require(process.returncode == expected_exit, "unexpected process result: " + json.dumps(record))
        if expected_exit in (91, 92):
            require(process.stdout == "" and "FAULT_REACHED " + mode in process.stderr,
                    "crash did not reach the scheduled atomic replacement")
            return None
        value = json.loads(process.stdout)
        if script == "compaction-audit-pending.py":
            ceiling(value, decision="decision" in value)
        return value

    def state(self):
        return json.loads(self.pending.read_bytes())

    def held(self, value):
        ceiling(value, decision=True)
        require(value["audit_state_required"] and value["state_dependent_decisions_held"],
                "outstanding obligation was silently cleared")
        require(value["decision"] == "AUDIT_STATE_REQUIRED" and not value["assigned_scope"],
                "unreserved pending scope changed")
        state = self.state()
        require(state["source"] is None and state["assignments"] == {}, "native state fabricated")
        require(all(row["consumed_version"] == 0 for row in state["observations"].values()),
                "unqualified scope was consumed")
        require(all(row["kind"] in ("UNRESOLVED_RESUME_OBSERVATION", "UNRESOLVED_SIGNAL")
                    and row["proof"]["logical_occurrence_count"] is None
                    and row["proof"]["delivery_count_is_not_occurrence_identity"] is True
                    for row in state["observations"].values()), "physical occurrence identity invented")
        return state

    def refused(self, name, action, data, reason, **options):
        before = self.snapshot()
        value = self.call(action, data, expected_exit=2, **options)
        require(value["status"] == "PENDING_OPERATION_REFUSED" and value["reason"] == reason,
                name + ": unexpected refusal " + json.dumps(value))
        require(before == self.snapshot(), name + ": refusal wrote fixture state")
        self.held(self.call("status"))
        self.mark(name)


def successor(before, after):
    """A resumed delivery changes only its version and the atomic state revision."""
    require(after["revision"] == before["revision"] + 1, "successor revision is incoherent")
    key = "unresolved-resume-" + sha(SESSION.encode())
    require(after["observations"][key]["version"] == before["observations"][key]["version"] + 1,
            "successor unresolved delivery version is incoherent")
    normalized = json.loads(json.dumps(after))
    normalized["revision"] = before["revision"]
    normalized["observations"][key]["version"] = before["observations"][key]["version"]
    require(normalized == before, "atomic successor altered unrelated pending state")


def materialize_selected_source(h):
    """Documented full frozen core plus all selected peer bytes; no native state.

    Only the pre-selection refusal is invoked from this source tree. It is not
    an admitted Git/controller/native composition and creates no Git refs.
    """
    commands = []

    def git(*args):
        command = ["git", "-C", str(h.repo), *args]
        process = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, timeout=15)
        commands.append({"command": command, "exit": process.returncode,
                         "stdout_bytes": len(process.stdout), "stdout_sha256": sha(process.stdout),
                         "stderr": process.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")})
        require(process.returncode == 0, "frozen source archive unavailable")
        return process.stdout

    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()
    archived = git("archive", "--format=tar", head, "skills", "source-peers")
    root = h.evidence / "constructed-source-tree"
    root.mkdir()
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archived)) as stream:
        for member in stream.getmembers():
            path = Path(member.name)
            require(not path.is_absolute() and ".." not in path.parts
                    and (member.isfile() or member.isdir()), "unexpected archived source member")
        stream.extractall(root, filter="data")
    selected = []
    for group in ("native-runtime", "route-graph"):
        relative = Path("source-peers") / group / "SOURCE_MANIFEST.json"
        require((root / relative).read_bytes() == (h.repo / relative).read_bytes(),
                "working peer manifest differs from frozen HEAD")
        manifest = json.loads((root / relative).read_bytes())
        for entry in manifest["files"]:
            source, target = root / entry["path"], root / entry["materialized_path"]
            raw = source.read_bytes()
            require(raw == (h.repo / entry["path"]).read_bytes()
                    and len(raw) == entry["bytes"] and sha(raw) == entry["sha256"],
                    "manifested source bytes differ: " + entry["path"])
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(raw)
            target.chmod(int(entry["mode"], 8) & 0o777)
            require(target.read_bytes() == raw
                    and stat.S_IMODE(target.stat().st_mode) == (int(entry["mode"], 8) & 0o777),
                    "materialized source bytes or mode differ")
            selected.append({key: entry[key] for key in ("path", "materialized_path", "bytes", "sha256", "mode")})
    record = {"frozen_commit": head, "scope": "SOURCE_ONLY_PRE_SELECTION_REFUSAL",
              "native_admission": "NOT_ESTABLISHED", "selected_file_count": len(selected),
              "selected_files": selected, "commands": commands}
    (h.evidence / "materialization-record.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    h.materialization = {key: record[key] for key in ("frozen_commit", "scope", "native_admission", "selected_file_count")}
    return root / "skills/implementaudit/scripts"


def exercise(h, reservation_refusal):
    repository, common, work = (h.fixture / name for name in ("repository", "git-common", "worktree"))
    run = work / ".IMPLEMENTAUDIT/runs/fixture"
    for path in (repository, common, run):
        path.mkdir(parents=True)
    initialized = h.call("init", script="host-session-binding.py",
                         args=["--store", str(h.store), "init", "--owner-id", OWNER])
    require(initialized["status"] == "READY", "fixture H0 store initialization failed")
    fields = {
        "owner-id": OWNER, "host-id": "codex", "host-session-id": SESSION,
        "controller-id": "fixture-controller", "claim-id": "fixture-claim",
        "explicit-run-root": run, "repository-identity": repository,
        "git-common-directory-identity": common, "worktree-identity": work,
        "activation-event-id": "fixture-activation", "activation-receipt": "opaque-fixture-activation",
        "continuity-generation": "G0001", "continuity-receipt": "opaque-fixture-continuity",
    }
    bound = h.call("bind", script="host-session-binding.py",
                   args=["--store", str(h.store), "bind",
                         *[part for key, value in fields.items() for part in ("--" + key, str(value))]])
    require(bound["status"] == "BOUND" and bound["host_activation_proven"] is False
            and bound["proof_layers"]["host_activation"] == "UNVERIFIED", "fixture attribution promoted")
    h.mark("constructed-attribution-remains-host-unproved")

    before = h.snapshot()
    empty = h.call("status", mode="status-guard")
    require(empty["decision"] == "NO_PENDING_AUDIT" and not h.pending.exists()
            and before == h.snapshot(), "empty status created pending state")
    h.mark("empty-status-three-reads-zero-observations-zero-writes")

    deliveries = [
        {"currentness": "UNRESOLVED", "measured_epoch": None},
        {"currentness": "UNRESOLVED", "measured_epoch": "G0002"},
        {"currentness": "VERIFIED", "measured_epoch": None},
    ]
    identifier = "unresolved-resume-" + sha(SESSION.encode())
    for version, limits in enumerate(deliveries, 1):
        result = h.call("resume", limits)
        state = h.held(result)
        require(list(state["observations"]) == [identifier]
                and state["observations"][identifier]["version"] == version
                and state["observations"][identifier]["proof"]["observed_limits"] == limits,
                "resume limits discarded or mistaken for occurrence proof")
        require(result == h.call("status"), "new process did not reload exact pending decision")
    h.mark("unresolved-currentness-or-absent-epoch-retains-durable-obligation")

    before = h.state()
    result = h.call("resume", deliveries[-1])
    successor(before, h.held(result))
    require(result == h.call("status"), "repeated resume did not survive restart")
    h.mark("repeated-resume-versions-one-unresolved-identity")

    before = h.snapshot()
    require(h.call("status", mode="status-guard") == result and before == h.snapshot(),
            "pending status observed or changed state")
    h.mark("pending-status-four-reads-zero-observations-zero-writes")

    original, before = h.pending.read_bytes(), h.state()
    h.call("resume", deliveries[-1], mode="before-replace", expected_exit=91)
    require(h.pending.read_bytes() == original, "pre-replacement crash lost original pending bytes")
    require(h.call("status") == result, "pre-replacement restart decision changed")
    h.held(result)
    # A fresh real writer must reacquire the exited process's lock and advance.
    result = h.call("resume", deliveries[-1])
    successor(before, h.held(result))
    require(h.call("status") == result, "post-crash real writer did not reload")
    h.mark("crash-before-replace-retains-original-and-releases-writer-lock")

    before = h.state()
    h.call("resume", deliveries[-1], mode="after-replace", expected_exit=92)
    result = h.call("status")
    successor(before, h.held(result))
    h.mark("crash-after-replace-reloads-coherent-unconsumed-successor")

    direct_scripts = h.scripts
    h.scripts = materialize_selected_source(h)
    fixture_source = h.fixture / "unregistered-fixture.jsonl"
    fixture_source.write_text('{"fixture":true}\n', encoding="utf-8")
    h.refused("source-registration-requires-unmodified-selected-native-profile", "register-source",
              {"task_id": SESSION, "transcript": str(fixture_source),
               "expected_bytes": fixture_source.stat().st_size, "expected_sha256": sha(fixture_source.read_bytes())},
              "NONPROTECTED_SELECTED_ROOT_REQUIRED")
    h.refused("native-profile-absence-refuses-reservation", "reserve",
              {"child_id": "fixture-child", "bounded_purpose": "portable refusal only",
               "observation_source": {key: {} for key in
                                      ("open", "spawn_call", "spawn_output", "child_activation", "parent_turn_start")}},
              reservation_refusal)
    # No assignment exists after the refused reservation. These exercise the
    # actual early FOREIGN_CHILD gate, not deeper native acceptance/JOIN logic.
    h.refused("unreserved-return-refuses-without-state-change", "return",
              {"child_id": "fixture-child", "observation_id": "absent", "result_evidence": {}}, "FOREIGN_CHILD")
    h.refused("unreserved-JOIN-refuses-without-state-change", "join",
              {"child_id": "fixture-child", "return_digest": "0" * 64, "acceptance": {}}, "FOREIGN_CHILD")
    h.scripts = direct_scripts
    h.refused("foreign-owner-cannot-modify-pending", "resume", deliveries[0],
              "HOST_CUSTODY_UNAVAILABLE: foreign store owner", owner="foreign-fixture-owner")
    h.refused("unknown-child-cannot-observe-pending", "observe-child", {"child_id": "unknown-child"}, "FOREIGN_CHILD")
    h.refused("status-rejects-observation-payload", "status", {}, "STATUS_IS_NONOBSERVING")
    h.refused("malformed-resume-retains-pending", "resume", {**deliveries[0], "unexpected": True},
              "RESUME_OBSERVATION_SHAPE")
    h.refused("nonobject-request-retains-pending", "reserve", [], "REQUEST_SHAPE")
    h.refused("duplicate-request-key-retains-pending", "resume", None, "DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY",
              raw='{"currentness":"UNRESOLVED","currentness":"VERIFIED","measured_epoch":null}')


def exercise_path_custody(h):
    """Absent state stays cheap; a present unsafe path cannot mean absence.

    Each mutation is confined to the constructed store. Existing pending bytes
    are retained separately and restored before the next control. No selector,
    observed native result, acceptance or JOIN is supplied.
    """
    original = h.pending.read_bytes()
    before = h.snapshot()
    regular = h.call("status")
    h.held(regular)
    require(before == h.snapshot(), "regular pending status wrote state")
    h.mark("path-custody-regular-pending-reloads-read-only")

    retained = h.pending.with_name("retained-path-custody.pending.json")
    h.pending.rename(retained)
    try:
        before = h.snapshot()
        absent = h.call("status")
        require(absent["decision"] == "NO_PENDING_AUDIT"
                and not absent["audit_state_required"]
                and not absent["state_dependent_decisions_held"]
                and before == h.snapshot(), "genuinely absent pending state changed")
        h.mark("path-custody-genuine-absence-remains-read-only")
    finally:
        retained.rename(h.pending)

    def refuses_without_write(name, action):
        before = h.snapshot()
        limits = {"currentness": "UNRESOLVED", "measured_epoch": None}
        value = h.call(action, limits if action == "resume" else None, expected_exit=2)
        require(value["status"] == "PENDING_OPERATION_REFUSED"
                and "decision" not in value,
                name + ": unsafe custody yielded a decision")
        require(before == h.snapshot(), name + ": refusal altered pending custody")
        h.mark(name)

    h.pending.rename(retained)
    try:
        h.pending.symlink_to(h.pending.with_name("absent-path-custody-target"))
        for action in ("status", "resume"):
            refuses_without_write("path-custody-dangling-file-refuses-" + action, action)
    finally:
        h.pending.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        retained.rename(h.pending)

    parent = h.pending.parent
    retained_parent = parent.with_name(parent.name + "-retained-path-custody")
    parent.rename(retained_parent)
    try:
        parent.symlink_to(parent.with_name("absent-path-custody-directory"), target_is_directory=True)
        for action in ("status", "resume"):
            refuses_without_write("path-custody-dangling-ancestor-refuses-" + action, action)
    finally:
        parent.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        retained_parent.rename(parent)

    h.pending.rename(retained)
    try:
        # A real FIFO detects an accidental blocking read where supported;
        # elsewhere an actual directory still exercises the nonregular fence.
        kind = "fifo" if hasattr(os, "mkfifo") else "directory"
        if kind == "fifo":
            os.mkfifo(h.pending)
        else:
            h.pending.mkdir()
        refuses_without_write("path-custody-" + kind + "-refuses-status", "status")
    finally:
        if h.pending.is_dir():
            h.pending.rmdir()
        else:
            h.pending.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        retained.rename(h.pending)

    require(h.pending.read_bytes() == original and h.call("status") == regular,
            "path custody controls changed the retained pending obligation")
    h.mark("path-custody-original-pending-restored-exactly")



def exercise_stored_json_custody(h):
    """Ambiguous stored keys cannot discard a genuine unconsumed obligation.

    Restoring CORE.read_json's ordinary parser must fail these actual-CLI
    controls. The exact old bytes are restored after each isolated mutation;
    no source registration, selected child or native event is constructed.
    """
    original = h.pending.read_bytes()
    before = h.snapshot()
    regular = h.call("status", mode="status-guard")
    state = h.held(regular)
    require(before == h.snapshot(), "unique-key pending status wrote state")
    h.mark("stored-json-unique-keys-remain-held-and-nonobserving")
    require(len(state["observations"]) == 1 and original.count(b'"consumed_version": 0') == 1,
            "stored-key fixture requires one real unconsumed observation")
    observation = next(iter(state["observations"].values()))
    top = original.rstrip()[:-1] + b',\n  "observations": {}\n}\n'
    nested = original.replace(b'"consumed_version": 0',
                              b'"consumed_version": 0, "consumed_version": '
                              + str(observation["version"]).encode("ascii"), 1)
    cases = [("duplicate-observations", top, action, "DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY")
             for action in ("status", "resume")]
    cases += [("duplicate-consumed-version", nested, action, "DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY")
              for action in ("status", "resume")]
    cases += [("utf16", original.decode("utf-8").encode("utf-16"), "status", None),
              ("utf8-bom", b"\xef\xbb\xbf" + original, "status", None)]
    failures = []
    for name, wire, action, reason in cases:
        case = "stored-json-" + name + "-refuses-" + action
        h.pending.write_bytes(wire)
        (h.evidence / (case + ".input")).write_bytes(wire)
        before = h.snapshot()
        try:
            value = h.call(action, {"currentness": "UNRESOLVED", "measured_epoch": None}
                           if action == "resume" else None, expected_exit=2)
            require(value["status"] == "PENDING_OPERATION_REFUSED" and "decision" not in value,
                    case + ": ambiguous stored bytes yielded a decision")
            require(value["reason"] == reason if reason is not None else
                    value["reason"].startswith("HOST_CUSTODY_UNAVAILABLE: compaction audit pending state is unreadable or malformed:"),
                    case + ": unexpected parser refusal")
            require(before == h.snapshot(), case + ": refusal wrote pending state")
            h.mark(case)
        except AssertionError as error:
            failures.append({"case": case, "error": str(error)})
        finally:
            h.pending.write_bytes(original)
            require(h.call("status") == regular and h.pending.read_bytes() == original,
                    case + ": restored pending obligation differs")

    retained = h.pending.with_name("retained-stored-json-open.pending.json")
    try:
        value = h.call("status", mode="pending-open-nonregular", expected_exit=2)
        require(value["status"] == "PENDING_OPERATION_REFUSED" and "decision" not in value,
                "scheduled nonregular open yielded a decision")
        require(retained.read_bytes() == original,
                "scheduled open changed retained pending bytes")
        h.mark("stored-json-preopen-nonregular-replacement-refuses")
    finally:
        if retained.exists():
            if h.pending.is_dir():
                h.pending.rmdir()
            else:
                h.pending.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            retained.rename(h.pending)
        require(h.call("status") == regular and h.pending.read_bytes() == original,
                "open-boundary restoration changed pending obligation")
    require(not failures, "stored JSON refusals failed: " + json.dumps(failures, sort_keys=True))



def exercise_stored_counter_positives(h):
    """Real integer producers and nonobserving readers retain their contract.

    The 2/1 and 2/2 rows are value fixtures only. They do not establish an
    accepted native return, JOIN or consumed-scope event.
    """
    original = h.pending.read_bytes()
    before = h.snapshot()
    regular = h.call("status", mode="status-guard")
    state = h.held(regular)
    require(before == h.snapshot(), "integer counter status wrote state")
    require(len(state["observations"]) == 1, "counter fixture needs one real observation")
    identifier, observation = next(iter(state["observations"].items()))
    require(type(observation["version"]) is int and observation["version"] > 0
            and type(observation["consumed_version"]) is int
            and observation["consumed_version"] == 0, "fixture producer emitted invalid counters")
    h.mark("stored-counter-genuine-integers-held-four-reads-zero-observations-zero-writes")

    retained = h.pending.with_name("retained-counter-positive.pending.json")
    h.pending.rename(retained)
    try:
        before = h.snapshot()
        absent = h.call("status", mode="status-guard")
        require(absent["decision"] == "NO_PENDING_AUDIT"
                and not absent["state_dependent_decisions_held"]
                and before == h.snapshot(), "absent counter status created state")
        h.mark("stored-counter-absence-three-reads-zero-observations-zero-writes")
    finally:
        retained.rename(h.pending)

    for consumed, expected, held in [(1, "AUDIT_STATE_REQUIRED", True),
                                      (2, "NO_PENDING_AUDIT", False)]:
        changed = json.loads(original)
        changed["observations"][identifier].update(version=2, consumed_version=consumed)
        wire = (json.dumps(changed, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
        h.pending.write_bytes(wire)
        try:
            before = h.snapshot()
            value = h.call("status")
            require(value["decision"] == expected
                    and value["state_dependent_decisions_held"] is held
                    and value["audit_state_required"] is held
                    and value["pending"] == ([{"id": identifier, "version": 2,
                                             "kind": observation["kind"]}] if held else [])
                    and value["assigned_scope"] == [] and before == h.snapshot(),
                    "valid value-only counter interval was misread")
            h.mark("stored-counter-value-only-two-" + str(consumed))
        finally:
            h.pending.write_bytes(original)
    try:
        resumed = h.call("resume", observation["proof"]["observed_limits"])
        after = h.held(resumed)
        successor(state, after)
        updated = after["observations"][identifier]
        require(type(updated["version"]) is int and type(updated["consumed_version"]) is int
                and h.call("status") == resumed, "real successor lost its integer pending state")
        h.mark("stored-counter-genuine-resume-preserves-integer-successor")
    finally:
        h.pending.write_bytes(original)
    require(h.pending.read_bytes() == original, "positive controls did not restore original bytes")


def exercise_stored_counter_refusals(h, selected=None):
    """Malformed counters cannot hide work or be rewritten by a later resume.

    Removing the load-time domain check must fail these actual status/resume
    controls. Every mutation changes one counter in a genuinely produced row;
    all other original bytes/values are restored before the next case.
    """
    original = h.pending.read_bytes()
    state = json.loads(original)
    require(len(state["observations"]) == 1, "counter fixture needs one real observation")
    identifier, observation = next(iter(state["observations"].items()))
    mutations = [
        ("version-nan", "version", float("nan")),
        ("version-boolean", "version", True),
        ("version-float", "version", 1.0),
        ("version-zero", "version", 0),
        ("version-negative", "version", -1),
        ("consumed-nan", "consumed_version", float("nan")),
        ("consumed-boolean", "consumed_version", True),
        ("consumed-float", "consumed_version", 0.0),
        ("consumed-negative", "consumed_version", -1),
        ("consumed-future", "consumed_version", observation["version"] + 1),
    ]
    cases = [(name, key, value, action) for name, key, value in mutations
             for action in ("status", "resume")]
    if selected is not None:
        require(set(selected) <= {name for name, _, _ in mutations}, "unknown counter test selection")
        cases = [row for row in cases if row[0] in selected]
    require(cases, "empty counter refusal selection")
    failures = []
    for name, key, bad_value, action in cases:
        case = "stored-counter-" + name + "-refuses-" + action
        changed = json.loads(original)
        changed["observations"][identifier][key] = bad_value
        wire = (json.dumps(changed, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
        h.pending.write_bytes(wire)
        (h.evidence / (case + ".input")).write_bytes(wire)
        before = h.snapshot()
        try:
            value = h.call(action, {"currentness": "UNRESOLVED", "measured_epoch": None}
                           if action == "resume" else None, expected_exit=2)
            require(value["status"] == "PENDING_OPERATION_REFUSED" and "decision" not in value
                    and value["reason"] == "PENDING_OBSERVATION_COUNTERS",
                    case + ": malformed counters yielded the wrong result")
            require(before == h.snapshot(), case + ": refusal changed the actual store")
            h.mark(case)
        except AssertionError as error:
            failures.append({"case": case, "error": str(error)})
        finally:
            h.pending.write_bytes(original)
            require(h.pending.read_bytes() == original, case + ": exact restoration failed")
    h.held(h.call("status", mode="status-guard"))
    require(h.pending.read_bytes() == original, "restored counter read changed pending bytes")
    require(not failures, "stored counter refusals failed: " + json.dumps(failures, sort_keys=True))


def source_pins(repo):
    # These are the owners executed/imported by this bounded CLI qualification.
    names = ("compaction-audit-pending.py", "host-session-binding.py", "compaction-result-observation.py",
             "compaction-source-owner-codex-app.py")

def reservation_refusal_profile(pins):
    # All qualified sources refuse before assignment. R0039 selects a profile
    # before acquiring the absent native selection, so its exact first guard
    # differs. Bind the same four source owners recorded by source_pins; do not
    # accept either reason interchangeably or infer it from the response.
    profiles = {
        ("9b5faf290e08d3df77b15d5e5301a3760c4e599d16719cf8f72e1768522ea691",
         "9ea603b9d923df5c155c7a5406ee2dac21cbc8fc87ec205f978e3130fbe43345",
         "2fcb390a3e4105adc1178000e736b1a09b3b5a59db03fdd744cda895a1352d04",
         "62558bb209129c66b55d2a97325d16db4aecfd2ecbeb71323dd44070a50f0890"):
            ("source-sha256:9b5faf290e08d3df77b15d5e5301a3760c4e599d16719cf8f72e1768522ea691", "NONPROTECTED_PROJECTION_PROFILE_REQUIRED"),
        ("2361a0026d108b551158eb865075912386eddb4878b71316560e46cc3597024d",
         "5848edf46581f885521fb677377f4742b630ac8ff0ab0b906ec0e00520fcf896",
         "1d7b7acaa9d1a481608ebf62ca5be8f30f25af0f5dc56d2bf4e795dce9c67c91",
         "62558bb209129c66b55d2a97325d16db4aecfd2ecbeb71323dd44070a50f0890"):
            ("2dccd7cbc7fb7866caff46ced84b4338c51a5b85", "NONPROTECTED_FIXED_SELECTION_UNBOUND"),
        ("50a67ea76a0c261627ff1a488f3916d33567404ed2d6b4fd068c909730d173f1",
         "5848edf46581f885521fb677377f4742b630ac8ff0ab0b906ec0e00520fcf896",
         "1d7b7acaa9d1a481608ebf62ca5be8f30f25af0f5dc56d2bf4e795dce9c67c91",
         "62558bb209129c66b55d2a97325d16db4aecfd2ecbeb71323dd44070a50f0890"):
            ("c013467cee36425630fbb6209a111c7642772ce2", "NONPROTECTED_FIXED_SELECTION_UNBOUND"),
        ("caca3f0a512b7c4e020fa8e6093e375e9ad849712e660612f82d680f90ebc0f9",
         "5848edf46581f885521fb677377f4742b630ac8ff0ab0b906ec0e00520fcf896",
         "1d7b7acaa9d1a481608ebf62ca5be8f30f25af0f5dc56d2bf4e795dce9c67c91",
         "62558bb209129c66b55d2a97325d16db4aecfd2ecbeb71323dd44070a50f0890"):
            ("068cb188acbac913088954a45dc1594846b2c81e", "NONPROTECTED_FIXED_SELECTION_UNBOUND"),
        ("0c673a96c86a131d73cb8dbf4ec0dce124943fd2f2c72c7b26af9a024249a986",

            ("b9fb34dbde3f344027e18aa427592e4853001c69", "NONPROTECTED_FIXED_SELECTION_UNBOUND"),
        ("e6516032d8d93e00a530c0753ed23e1b51cdcf2b27e45611b3923f3922718c34",
         "38236d9247b66202807f55c36e8505335c73c5129778cd16b3180661690578e4",
         "439b4efaddbe7c3a19b625db0e8480d7a857ebc603be34cb9e9bbec575902581",
         "62558bb209129c66b55d2a97325d16db4aecfd2ecbeb71323dd44070a50f0890"):
            ("8fd58276a50ae069ed71d52be01c775047ce692a", "NONPROTECTED_PROJECTION_PROFILE_REQUIRED"),
        ("e6516032d8d93e00a530c0753ed23e1b51cdcf2b27e45611b3923f3922718c34",
         "9ea603b9d923df5c155c7a5406ee2dac21cbc8fc87ec205f978e3130fbe43345",

    }
    names = ("compaction-audit-pending.py", "compaction-result-observation.py",
             "compaction-source-owner-codex-app.py", "host-session-binding.py")
    identity = tuple(pins.get(str(PEER / name)) for name in names)
    require(identity in profiles, "unqualified portable reservation-refusal source profile")
    checkpoint, reason = profiles[identity]
    return {"qualified_checkpoint": checkpoint, "expected_reason": reason}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repo-root", type=Path, default=ROOT)
    parser.add_argument("--evidence-dir", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    repo = args.repo_root.resolve(strict=True)
    evidence = args.evidence_dir.absolute() if args.evidence_dir else Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cognition-pending-durability-"))
    if args.evidence_dir:
        evidence.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    evidence = evidence.resolve(strict=True)
    h = Harness(repo, evidence)
    pins = source_pins(repo)
    report = {"scope": "PORTABLE_ACTUAL_OWNER_CLI_PROCESS_CRASH_ONLY", "evidence_dir": str(evidence),
              "host_activation_proven": False, "native_activation": "UNPROVED",
              "authentic_physical_boundary": "UNPROVED", "native_JOIN_consumption": "UNPROVED",
              "native_lifecycle": "NOT_CLAIMED", "native_producer_runtime_equivalence": "UNVERIFIED",
              "source_file_count": len(pins), "source_sha256": pins, "limitations": LIMITATIONS, **CEILING}
    try:
        profile = reservation_refusal_profile(pins)
        report["reservation_refusal_profile"] = profile
        # Refuse to run this portable fixture against a privately selected
        # native runtime. This reads the unchanged source; it never clears pins.
        tree = ast.parse((repo / PEER / "compaction-source-owner-codex-app.py").read_bytes())
        selections = [ast.literal_eval(node.value) for node in tree.body
                      if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
                      and any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "NONPROTECTED_SELECTION_PIN"
                              for target in node.targets)]
        require(selections == [None], "portable test requires the original absent native selection")
        exercise(h, profile["expected_reason"])
        exercise_path_custody(h)
        exercise_stored_json_custody(h)
        exercise_stored_counter_positives(h)
        exercise_stored_counter_refusals(h)
        require(source_pins(repo) == pins, "actual source owners changed during qualification")
        report["result"] = "PASS"
    except Exception as error:
        report.update(result="FAIL", error=str(error), traceback=traceback.format_exc())
    finally:
        report.update(controls=len(h.controls), control_names=h.controls, process_count=len(h.records),
                      source_unchanged=source_pins(repo) == pins,
                      materialization=getattr(h, "materialization", None))
        (evidence / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True))
    return 0 if report["result"] == "PASS" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "--worker":
        raise SystemExit(worker(*sys.argv[2:]))
    raise SystemExit(main())
