metadata.body:
## Purpose and authority

Related to #207 (R0033) and #211 (R0037). These are **non-closing references**. This is the sole combined draft PR, with two independently reconstructable original acceptance contracts. No release, merge, issue closure, real-home installation, protected-controller mutation or native-host admission is authorized by this PR.

The integration strengthens the existing four-child governor and its nested L1–L5 control through the original semantic owners. It retains exactly `audit-state`, `audit-assess`, `audit-implement`, and `audit-andon`; no fifth child, second router, generic executor or new lifecycle controller is introduced.

## Exact candidate and logical history

- Branch: `pro/r0033-r0037-20261023`
- Base: `e78f7cb21af4197d490f10bc95917a4c75f748aa`
- Current head: `b9fb34dbde3f344027e18aa427592e4853001c69`
- Current tree: `0da28068921b9446767034c438463f40f4435b81`
- Source manifest SHA-256: `e480a3d6b4eff4d1adac74367a68c28d991948cca22d8444fdb1a4df9f7cddf9`

All updates used the supported GitHub integration with exact expected-head guards and `force=false`. The final API tree equals the reviewed local index tree; the fetched local candidate is clean.

| Commit | Independently reconstructable contribution |
|---|---|
| `5b39fbe02e9cf5ef24721d150307e33cdddf1a34` | Exact already-accepted PR217 finite-cap restoration |
| `8197d00a4f61616441800ce551e2eb674f392c25` | R0033 evidential-support v2 child and current-envelope consumer |
| `da29ef870dcf310557f463989ade10ba44318d37` | R0037 truthful nonterminal-yield predicate |
| `61081882f95bcc8c40685195b0b26a98a3f99a5b` | Shared integration and two original acceptance ledgers |
| `4470b6c11ff517b206e33d461bc1643817b2c789` | R0033 real pending-owner process-crash/reload and refusal controls |
| `bafc7d7960068f26b82d5cd20e6fe1f6b519e2f9` | R0037 supplemental closure/handoff/yield composition |
| `c0573094fc67219fce40ecff0e31198ca33f4eef` | Successor source identities and separate acceptance/continuation records |
| `40baa43e792c95f8ad49cea8dccfd85ac42b94d7` | Restore original structural caller after a preserved hosted regression |
| `2f7dbe1a46b70083802c018d73b08791daedc010` | Reconcile two stale continuity assertions with the existing audit-round contract; preserve paired marker regressions |
| `b9fb34dbde3f344027e18aa427592e4853001c69` | Restore the accepted deployment support-state bound after an actual installed semantic partial |

## Implemented engineering

**R0033.** The existing audit-implement child now has a coherent `implementaudit.evidential-support.v2` contract. Both subject branches retain common verified maintainer admission. Release subjects retain exact candidate/release-currentness requirements; non-release propositions bind their actual subject, configuration, evidence, consumer and decision-time currentness. The six legacy semantic dispositions and two deterministic precondition refusals remain distinct. Actual governor pre-load/post-return calls compare the fresh envelope before opening the result. Ordinary and mechanically settled work retains the zero-child path.

The new pending-durability regression executes the existing supported owners in 17 controls / 38 real processes. It retains unresolved-currentness and absent-epoch obligations, checks cheap nonobserving status, interrupts the real atomic replacement before and after its commit point, recovers from a fresh process, and exercises actual source-selection/reservation refusals. Failed reservation cannot manufacture a child return, JOIN or consumption. No native selection pins or source peers were altered. The proof is process-crash/reload durability, not power-loss or authentic physical-compaction admission.

The final semantic repair restores the accepted local-evidence/broader-deployment state bound in the existing shared return contract: CONDITIONAL with exact transport qualifications or NOT_SUPPORTED for the unsupported requested boundary, without inventing factual failure. Other missing-evidence judgments retain UNRESOLVED, and a separately stated narrow proposition can remain SUPPORTED. The real original S02 conservative partial is retained; fresh successor interpretation is pending. Schema, legacy tokens, child/governor source and executable validators are unchanged by this narrow repair. Independent exact four-file source review: `c14b70a114d3a5469e9cac4a3dc2d8e5461c85bf7ab29d7f641ef32b70b16f22`.

**R0037.** PR217's accepted rejection of arbitrary fixed terminal caps is restored exactly. L4 return instructions identify the interrupted nested owner and selective revalidation. The existing run-root validator supports truthful nonterminal yields, including prephase `OUTSIDE_PHASE` pauses, exact read-set rechecks and nonblocking unsafe-file refusal.

Its additional `--turn-disposition` mode composes existing owners for `TERMINAL_CLOSURE`, `AUDITED_HANDOFF`, and `NONTERMINAL_YIELD`. Actual claims take precedence over the requested branch. Success-shaped child output, open objects, unresolved reviews or obligations, stale records, and owner-source substitutions cannot establish closure. Full packaged-owner custody detects directory rename/swap/restore. The original full final-audit path remains normative; this is a **supplemental bounded portable profile**. `OUT_OF_PROFILE` grants neither a disposition nor bypass permission. Successful portable output retains authority NONE and false native-enforcement/effect-authority flags.

**Shared source.** Governor, transcript/PROTOCOL, run-root owner, existing helper inventory and semantic identity pins are composed once. Only fourteen existing governor SHA fields were rebound; semantic oracles, package limits, compatibility requirements and the workflow were preserved.

## Focused and composed evidence

| Population | Actual result and boundary |
|---|---|
| audit-implement v2 | 153 actual helper CLI invocations; 23 methods; common maintainer gate retained |
| Pending durability/refusal | 17 controls / 38 owner processes; actual crash/reload; no accepted native JOIN claim |
| Existing pending value / observation / physical-source selections | 16 value-function controls, 19 observation-oracle controls, 5 selected physical-source regressions; original layers remain distinct |
| Nested cognition composition | 17 constructed cross-owner controls; no authenticated live-chain credit |
| Nonterminal yields | 77 portable record controls |
| Supplemental dispositions | 44/44 focused controls, 7/7 independent held-outs, independent actual source-directory ABA refusal |
| Terminal-cap restoration | 28 controls, including 23 rejecting negatives |
| Installed fresh interpretation | Separate narrow 2-case × 2-projection follow-up: 4 bounded passes, native positives 0; previous 15/16 plus one partial retained |
| Original eight semantic first outcomes at 2f7 | 7 bounded PASS, 1 conservative state-rule partial; all first outputs and source-read ledgers preserved; native positives 0 |

Independent review found and repaired actual deficiencies, including a missing import, common maintainer ceiling, prephase pause applicability, FIFO/read-set races, and source-directory ABA custody. Original failing observations remain in the evidence capture. Four paired cold reads support L4 clarification without inventing an unsafe baseline.

Final governor: 21,099 bytes / 396 lines, reserve 901 >= 741. Existing census: 29 helpers / 19 modes. Final whole source review verifies all 24 manifest entries and exact preimages. Independent prior delivery review `a6e5b906...` verifies the exact 2f7 package/reuse receipt. The new changed-contract package receipt is undergoing its own independent review; previous source-bound results are retained.

## Exact final packages and official isolated installations

Two fresh official builds at `b9fb34dbde3f344027e18aa427592e4853001c69` are byte-identical. All four official isolated projections — Codex plugin, Claude plugin, Codex standalone, Claude standalone — match source-bound inventories, populations, bytes and modes. Every child resolves within its projection. All **30 fresh subprocesses** passed: two builders, four installers, sixteen resolutions, and eight installed-consumer processes. Each projection newly executed the **17 composition + 44 disposition controls**; these are not reused runs. Claude standalone remains a file-copy workaround, with no live Desktop import claimed.

Compared with qualified 2f7 archives, each new archive changes only the shared transcript member and inventory. Complete populations and modes are unchanged. The 775-byte source clarification is bound by transcript SHA-256 `492ea1bb6015c69cbab49d29f1bfdeca30770ecfdab627473e5662e7cf5eef4e`.

| Artifact | Bytes | SHA-256 | Headroom below unchanged 458,752-byte cap |
|---|---:|---|---:|
| `IMPLEMENTAUDIT.plugin.zip` | 422,460 | `df903a6a957fea6e4159f95058226de14cb6f4cd817a0aac528154394692a794` | 36,292 bytes |
| `IMPLEMENTAUDIT.skill` | 417,990 | `03994ec40abecf2037d32bf085b1eaf909fd195dcdd4b7b59782f4941ddc5c5a` | 40,762 bytes |

The required 2,000-byte reserve is preserved. New receipt SHA-256: `a180b3dbd606179d1a946060bb917e8018e979b95166b8f64aa489a600dc9e87`. Source was clean before and after. Earlier 61081882, 40baa and 2f7 package/install receipts retain their exact qualification; 2f7's 22-process complete-payload reuse proof does not qualify the changed b9fb contract. Native qualification count remains zero.

## Hosted CI and preserved failures

- [Initial full run 40030184800](https://github.com/theislampill/IMPLEMENTAUDIT.md/actions/runs/40030184800) **passed** on the 61081882 candidate; tested merge tree exactly equals that candidate tree.
- [Intermediate run 40036017402](https://github.com/theislampill/IMPLEMENTAUDIT.md/actions/runs/40036017402) **failed** the mandatory planner caller literal. The same-source local RED is retained. The final repair restores the original two structural-call lines; no checker or workflow was weakened. Planner and complete static-prefix checks passed at their stated scope.
- [Run 40037118624](https://github.com/theislampill/IMPLEMENTAUDIT.md/actions/runs/40037118624) **failed** two obsolete continuity assertions (2/39) on exact 40baa/tree504ef. Its complete original log SHA-256 is `b764be72258389fb4fa05dc8d8c005af1936c5fa8c6c2ad7b7c7100ef97041fa`. Direct audit-andon and the same-source local RED localized acceptance-instrument drift. The next commit updates the two assertions to per-round nonterminal/final-once semantics and preserves both no-replay checks. Continuity **41/41**, the full marker bank and the registry pass. The added two-round positive/reversed-final-order negative already passed the unchanged checker at the preimage; no runtime defect or missing-marker completeness is invented. Exact six-file review SHA-256: `10454b348e51d0b654841edd0c1d6c0be84b6293a29ccb52fa1cf50121655a07`.
- [Delivery run 40039641603](https://github.com/theislampill/IMPLEMENTAUDIT.md/actions/runs/40039641603) is **IN PROGRESS**. Tested merge `828cbdacd5432ffb28e12a97449da260b9d92940` has exact tree `633325b241099761a2d1514b0e6516e2f6f66223` and actual parents base + delivery candidate. Its terminal result remains pending; earlier successful gates do not substitute for it.

- [Current run 40041887651](https://github.com/theislampill/IMPLEMENTAUDIT.md/actions/runs/40041887651) is **IN PROGRESS**, job `120714638169`. GitHub current test merge `a741c11a661338fd8c3d8576159cd6c0bd12c707` has exact tree `0da28068921b9446767034c438463f40f4435b81` and parents base + b9fb candidate; local Git-object inspection confirms those identities. The terminal checkout/job log is still pending. Neither the prior run nor focused tests substitute for the actual current terminal result.

The earlier local full-gate exit 1 remains a failure: generated fixture residue was rejected by the source-pack boundary. Actual audit-andon diagnosis, exact preserved/quarantined fixture/cache inventories, and the scoped unchanged pack recovery are retained. Split recovery is not relabeled an unbroken full-package pass. Earlier scarce-resource and interrupted-run evidence likewise remains distinct. A brief later executor disconnect made no writes; exact recovery was verified before publication.

## Concurrent-owner composition

| Read-only input | Latest inspected head | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| PR246 / R0035 | `04573f3f8c7e50c15255d213c185605681c1ffdd` | Exact restored-governor composition passes the actual default budget at 21,248 bytes, reserve 752 >= 741 (11-byte margin); same fourteen SHA fields only |
| PR251 | `488e5d14fc6fb4901690213a8b92d22ac7025ef9` | Completed portable work retained as read-only input; large accepted programme not repeated |
| PR252 / R0039 | `8fd58276a50ae069ed71d52be01c775047ce692a` | Prior affected composition passes 44 selector + 77 TY controls, full run-root wrapper and 30-helper/22-mode census. Latest successor changes one test-fixture lifecycle file only; all 1,402 other Git entries are unchanged, and its one new disposal control passes. Runtime evidence is explicitly reused, not claimed as a fresh full run |

No other-owner branch was written or unmerged runtime proposal imported. The R0039/PR251 executed-buffer and physical-path/module-custody overlap remains **FROZEN_NOT_APPLIED**. R0035 dispatch/READY/JOIN, R0036 ordinary task custody, and R0039 canonical rotation/archive retain their owners.

## Two independent acceptance assessments

**R0033 — substantive portable implementation and focused qualification; original issue acceptance OPEN.** Authentic selected-source/host admission, physical selected/prior/current/retry and first-original-result identity, actual full-payload LOAD/use/return, acceptance, R0035 JOIN and covered-scope consumption, typed capability/authority-NONE effect containment and original native populations remain unproved. Receiving-source integration may still be necessary after the existing owners' genuine admission decisions. The excluded ATTRIBUTED-to-enforcement hook must not be restored. Earlier post-compaction failures remain failed.

**R0037 — substantive portable implementation and focused qualification; original issue acceptance OPEN.** Native Stop remains `UNSUPPORTED_HOST_EFFECT_AUTHENTICATION`. Actual session-bound closure/handoff/yield consumption, original TY-1–TY-6, binding, host and nested/terminal populations require the properly equipped accepting owners. Forced host exit is never audit completion. The supplemental record checker is not universal native actuation.

Independent original semantic qualification now records the complete eight-case first distribution: seven bounded passes and one conservative partial. The novel domain, irrelevant proof, local/non-transport, checksum, narrow positive, ordinary correction and release-positive cases passed at their constructed scope. The correlated-evidence reader correctly withheld deployment but reasoned to UNRESOLVED contrary to the specific accepted state rule. That is a real semantic decision-rule miss, not an unsafe support claim or a formatting-only defect. The source repair above responds to it. Five fresh affected successor cases are being prepared and their success is **not yet claimed**. Original responses/oracles remain immutable; all actual child-file reads are source consultation, not authenticated native LOAD/use/acceptance. The 153 value calls do not establish semantic sufficiency. Original released R0037 evidence remains reusable under its terminal census, with no blanket population replay.

Both original bodies and every comment were refreshed and compared byte-for-byte with intake; no contract changes were found. Prospective role-event/cross-triad/BWP/AMA retention proposals remain subject to their receiving and authority decisions.

Separate [R0033 ledger](docs/audits/archive/r0033-r0037-integration/R0033-ACCEPTANCE.md), [R0037 ledger](docs/audits/archive/r0033-r0037-integration/R0037-ACCEPTANCE.md), [source identities](docs/audits/archive/r0033-r0037-integration/SOURCE-IDENTITIES.json), and [same-PR continuation/coordinator return](docs/audits/archive/r0033-r0037-integration/CONTINUATION.md) retain original populations, source units, limitations and rollback obligations. A green combined CI will not certify either issue. Final acceptance and manual GitHub closure require separate entitled owner decisions.
